It is intentionally not a semantic ontology and carries no ownership or champion-binding information; champion alias rules are lexical spelling data only and never produce entities, bindings, events, or relations.

champion_abilities.name: Conflagration
champion_abilities.description: Brand conjures a powerful blast at his target that spreads to nearby enemies, dealing magic damage. If the target is ablaze, Conflagration's spread is doubled.

champion_abilities.name: Blaze
champion_abilities.description: Brand's spells light his targets ablaze, dealing damage over 4 seconds, stacking up to 3 times. If Brand kills an enemy while it is ablaze he regains mana. When Blaze reaches max stacks on a Champion or large monster, it becomes unstable. It detonates in 2 seconds, applying spell effects and dealing massive damage in an area around the victim.

champion_abilities.name: Sear
champion_abilities.description: Brand launches a ball of fire forward that deals magic damage. If the target is ablaze, Sear will stun the target.

champion_abilities.name: Pyroclasm
champion_abilities.description: Brand unleashes a devastating torrent of fire that bounces up to 5 times off of Brand and nearby enemies, dealing magic damage to enemies each time bounce. Bounces prioritize stacking Blaze to max on Champions. If a target is ablaze, Pyroclasm will briefly slow them.

champion_abilities.name: Pillar of Flame
champion_abilities.description: After a short delay, Brand creates a Pillar of Flame at a target area, dealing magic damage to enemy units within the area. Units that are ablaze take an additional 25% damage.

champion_abilities.name: 90 Caliber Net
champion_abilities.description: Caitlyn fires a heavy net to slow her target. The recoil knocks Caitlyn back.

champion_abilities.name: Headshot
champion_abilities.description: Every few basic attacks, or against a target she has trapped or netted, Caitlyn will fire a headshot dealing bonus damage that scales with her critical strike chance. On trapped or netted targets, Caitlyn's Headshot attack range is doubled.

champion_abilities.name: Piltover Peacemaker
champion_abilities.description: Caitlyn revs up her rifle for 1 second to unleash a penetrating shot that deals physical damage (deals less damage to subsequent targets).

champion_abilities.name: Ace in the Hole
champion_abilities.description: Caitlyn takes time to line up the perfect shot, dealing massive damage to a single target at a huge range. Enemy champions can intercept the bullet for their ally.

champion_abilities.name: Yordle Snap Trap
champion_abilities.description: Caitlyn sets a trap that, when sprung, reveals and immobilizes the enemy champion for 1.5 seconds, granting Caitlyn an empowered Headshot.

champion_abilities.name: Hookshot
champion_abilities.description: Camille pulls herself to a wall, leaping off and knocking up enemy champions upon landing.

champion_abilities.name: Adaptive Defenses
champion_abilities.description: Basic attacks on champions grant a shield equal to a percentage of Camille's maximum health against their damage type (Physical or Magic) for a brief duration.

champion_abilities.name: Precision Protocol
champion_abilities.description: Camille's next attack deals bonus damage and grants bonus Move Speed. This spell can be recast for a short period of time, doing significantly increased bonus damage if Camille delays a period of time between the two attacks.

champion_abilities.name: The Hextech Ultimatum
champion_abilities.description: Camille dashes to target champion, anchoring them to the area. She also deals bonus magic damage to the target with her basic attacks.

champion_abilities.name: Tactical Sweep
champion_abilities.description: Camille blasts in a cone after a delay, dealing damage. Enemies in the outer half are slowed and take extra damage, while also healing Camille.

champion_abilities.name: Lunar Rush
champion_abilities.description:
Becomes the living embodiment of the vengeful moon, dashing to an enemy and dealing magic damage.

Lunar Rush has no cooldown when used to dash to an enemy afflicted with Moonlight. All other enemies will have the Moonlight debuff removed regardless of whether they were the target of Lunar Rush.

champion_abilities.name: Moonsilver Blade
champion_abilities.description: Every third strike cleaves nearby enemies for an additional magic damage. After casting a spell, Diana gains Attack Speed for 5 seconds.

champion_abilities.name: Crescent Strike
champion_abilities.description:
Unleashes a bolt of lunar energy in an arc dealing magic damage.

Afflicts enemies struck with Moonlight, revealing them if they are not stealthed for 3 seconds.

champion_abilities.name: Moonfall
champion_abilities.description:
Diana reveals and draws in all nearby enemies and slows them.

If Diana pulls in one or more enemy champions, the moonlight crashes down onto her after a short delay, dealing magic damage in an area around her, increased for each target beyond the first pulled.

champion_abilities.name: Pale Cascade
champion_abilities.description: Diana creates three orbiting spheres that detonate on contact with enemies to deal damage in an area. She also gains a temporary shield that absorbs damage. If her third sphere detonates, the shield gains additional strength.

champion_abilities.name: Cocoon / Rappel
champion_abilities.description:
Human Form: Stuns the first enemy unit hit and reveals them if they are not stealthed.

Spider Form: Elise and her Spiderlings ascend into the air and then descend upon target enemy. After descending on an enemy target, Elise's bonus damage and healing from Spider Queen is increased.

champion_abilities.name: Spider Queen
champion_abilities.description:
Human Form: When Elise's abilities hit an enemy, she gains a dormant Spiderling.

Spider Form: Basic attacks deal bonus magic damage and restore health to Elise.

champion_abilities.name: Neurotoxin / Venomous Bite
champion_abilities.description:
Human Form: Deals damage based upon how high the target's Health is.

Spider Form: Lunges at an enemy and deals damage based upon how low their Health is.

champion_abilities.name: Spider Form
champion_abilities.description: Transforms into a menacing spider, reducing her attack range in exchange for Move Speed, new abilities, and a Spiderling swarm that will attack her foes.

champion_abilities.name: Volatile Spiderling / Skittering Frenzy
champion_abilities.description:
Human Form: Releases a venom-gorged Spiderling that explodes when it nears a target.

Spider Form: Elise and her Spiderlings gain Attack Speed.

champion_abilities.name: Defile
champion_abilities.description: Karthus passively steals energy from his victims, gaining Mana on each kill. Alternatively, Karthus can surround himself in the souls of his prey, dealing damage to nearby enemies, but quickly draining his own Mana.

champion_abilities.name: Death Defied
champion_abilities.description: Upon dying, Karthus enters a spirit form that allows him to continue casting spells.

champion_abilities.name: Lay Waste
champion_abilities.description: Karthus unleashes a delayed blast at a location, dealing damage to nearby enemies. Deals increased damage to isolated enemies.

champion_abilities.name: Requiem
champion_abilities.description: After channeling for 3 seconds, Karthus deals damage to all enemy champions.

champion_abilities.name: Wall of Pain
champion_abilities.description: Karthus creates a passable screen of leeching energy. Any enemy units that walk through the screen have their Move Speed and Magic Resist reduced for a period.

champion_abilities.name: Zenith Blade
champion_abilities.description: Leona projects a solar image of her sword, dealing magic damage to all enemies in a line. When the image fades, the last enemy champion struck will be briefly immobilized and Leona will dash to them.

champion_abilities.name: Sunlight
champion_abilities.description: Damaging spells afflict enemies with Sunlight for 1.5 seconds. When allied Champions deal damage to those targets, they consume the Sunlight to deal additional magic damage.

champion_abilities.name: Shield of Daybreak
champion_abilities.description: Leona uses her shield to perform her next basic attack, dealing bonus magic damage and stunning the target.

champion_abilities.name: Solar Flare
champion_abilities.description: Leona calls down a beam of solar energy, dealing damage to enemies in an area. Enemies in the center of the area are stunned, while enemies on the outside are slowed.

champion_abilities.name: Eclipse
champion_abilities.description: Leona raises her shield to gain Damage Reduction, Armor, and Magic Resist. When the duration first ends, if there are nearby enemies, she will deal magic damage to them and prolong the duration of the effect.

champion_abilities.name: Tidecaller's Blessing
champion_abilities.description: Empowers an allied champion for a short duration. The ally's basic attacks and spells deal bonus magic damage and slow the target.

champion_abilities.name: Surging Tides
champion_abilities.description: When Nami's Abilities hit allied champions they gain Move Speed for a short duration.

champion_abilities.name: Aqua Prison
champion_abilities.description: Sends a bubble to a target area, dealing damage and stunning all enemies on impact.

champion_abilities.name: Tidal Wave
champion_abilities.description: Summons a massive Tidal Wave that knocks up, slows, and damages enemies. Allies hit gain double the effect of Surging Tides.

champion_abilities.name: Ebb and Flow
champion_abilities.description: Unleashes a stream of water that bounces back and forth between allied and enemy champions, healing allies and damaging enemies.

champion_abilities.name: Reckless Swing
champion_abilities.description: Olaf attacks with such force that it deals true damage to his target and himself, refunding the Health cost if he destroys the target.

champion_abilities.name: Berserker Rage
champion_abilities.description: Olaf gains Attack Speed and Life Steal based on his missing Health.

champion_abilities.name: Undertow
champion_abilities.description: Olaf throws an axe into the ground at a target location, dealing damage to enemies it passes through and reducing their Armor and Move Speed. If Olaf picks up the axe, the ability's cooldown is reset.

champion_abilities.name: Ragnarok
champion_abilities.description: Olaf passively gains increased armor and magic resist. He can activate this ability to become immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking.

champion_abilities.name: Tough It Out
champion_abilities.description: Olaf's Attack Speed is increased and he gains a Shield.

champion_abilities.name: Bola Strike
champion_abilities.description:
Rengar throws a bola, slowing the first target hit for a short duration.

Ferocity effect: roots the target.

champion_abilities.name: Unseen Predator
champion_abilities.description:
While in Brush, Rengar leaps at his target with his basic attack.

Rengar generates Ferocity whenever he casts an ability. At Max Ferocity, his next ability is empowered.

Killing enemy champions awards trophies on Rengar's Bonetooth Necklace, granting bonus attack damage.

champion_abilities.name: Savagery
champion_abilities.description:
Rengar's next Attack brutally stabs his target for bonus damage.

Ferocity effect: deals increased damage and grants Attack Speed.

champion_abilities.name: Thrill of the Hunt
champion_abilities.description: Rengar's predatory instincts take over, <font color='#cd90ee'>Camouflaging</font> him and revealing the nearest enemy champion in a large radius around him. During Thrill of the Hunt, Rengar gains Move Speed and he can leap to the tracked enemy without being in brush, reducing their armor.

champion_abilities.name: Battle Roar
champion_abilities.description:
Rengar lets out a battle roar, damaging enemies and healing for some of the recent damage he has taken.

Ferocity effect: additionally breaks crowd control effects.

champion_abilities.name: Assassin's Path
champion_abilities.description: Talon vaults over any terrain or structure, up to a max distance. This ability has a low cooldown, but puts the used terrain on a long cooldown.

champion_abilities.name: Blade's End
champion_abilities.description: Talon's spells Wound champions and large monsters, stacking up to 3 times. When Talon attacks a champion with 3 stacks of Wound, they bleed for heavy damage over time.

champion_abilities.name: Noxian Diplomacy
champion_abilities.description: Talon stabs the target unit. If they are within melee range, this attack deals critical damage. If they are outside melee range, Talon will leap at his target before stabbing them. Talon refunds some health and cooldown if this ability kills the target.

champion_abilities.name: Shadow Assault
champion_abilities.description: Talon disperses a ring of blades and becomes Invisible while gaining additional Move Speed. When Talon emerges from Invisibility, the blades converge on his location. Each time the blades move, Shadow Assault deals physical damage to enemies hit by at least one blade.

champion_abilities.name: Rake
champion_abilities.description: Talon sends out a volley of daggers that then return back to him, dealing physical damage every time it passes through an enemy. The returning blades deal bonus damage and slow units hit.

champion_abilities.name: Hail of Arrows
champion_abilities.description: Varus fires a hail of arrows that deal physical damage and desecrate the ground. Desecrated ground slows enemies' Move Speed and reduces their self healing and regeneration.

champion_abilities.name: Living Vengeance
champion_abilities.description: On kill or assist, Varus temporarily gains Attack Damage and Ability Power. This bonus is larger if the enemy is a champion.

champion_abilities.name: Piercing Arrow
champion_abilities.description: Varus readies and then fires a powerful shot that gains extra range and damage the longer he spends preparing to fire.

champion_abilities.name: Chain of Corruption
champion_abilities.description: Varus flings out a damaging tendril of corruption that immobilizes the first enemy champion hit and then spreads towards nearby uninfected champions, immobilizing them too on contact.

champion_abilities.name: Blighted Quiver
champion_abilities.description: Passive: Varus' basic attacks deal bonus magic damage and apply Blight. Varus' other abilities detonate Blight, dealing magic damage based on the target's maximum Health. Active: Varus empowers his next Piercing Arrow.

instructions.role: You are extracting source-grounded semantic information from a League of Legends coaching transcript.
task_rules: Use only information supported by the supplied source material and metadata.
The target passage is marked explicitly; extract meaning FOR THE TARGET PASSAGE.
Resolve pronouns, champion references, and ability ownership only when the supplied material supports the resolution.
Do not invent strategic conclusions that are merely plausible League advice.
Do not normalize results into higher-level strategic concepts such as access, continuity, initiative, beatdown, or conversion unless the coach explicitly states that concept.
Do not repair ASR corruption beyond what the supplied vocabulary and context support; record unrecoverable spans as unresolved.
Preserve uncertainty: use resolution_status 'unresolved' whenever a binding or span cannot be supported.

fields.actors_entities: Champions, players, and other entities the target passage is about. Preserve literal surface names when the source wording is used; mark context-resolved bindings explicitly.
fields.reference_bindings: Every pronoun or reference in the target passage and what it binds to. If a reference cannot be resolved from the supplied material, record it with resolution_status 'unresolved' instead of guessing.
fields.abilities_resources: Ability, summoner spell, item, and resource references, including whose ability each one is when the source supports ownership.
fields.events_actions: Concrete things that happened or were done in the game, as stated or entailed by the source.
fields.states: Game states that hold during the target passage: health, mana, cooldowns, position, wave states, objective states, and similar.
fields.conditions: Explicit or clearly implied conditions under which events, advice, or consequences hold ('if', 'when', 'until', 'unless' content).
fields.recommended_advice: Advice or recommended actions the coach actually gives in the target passage. Do not invent plausible League advice the coach did not state.
fields.consequences_outcomes: Stated or clearly implied consequences and outcomes of events, states, or (non-)compliance with advice.
fields.explicit_relationships: Typed relationships between extracted items using ONLY the supplied relation_types vocabulary. Each relationship must be supported by the source.
fields.uncertainty_unresolved: Spans or bindings the speaker or you are uncertain about, ASR corruptions that cannot be recovered, and references that remain unresolved. Preserving uncertainty is required; resolving it by guessing is forbidden.
fields.supporting_source_spans: The minimal source spans that jointly support the extraction for this target passage.

grounding_rules: Every extracted item must cite at least one source reference.

A source reference is an exact contiguous 'quote' copied byte-for-byte from the condition's supplied source text plus a zero-based 'occurrence_index' counted among all exact non-overlapping substring matches of that quote in the condition source.
Never supply character offsets; deterministic tooling resolves your quotes to ranges.
Condition A source text is the supplied Bronze target passage. Condition B source text is the supplied full transcript.
For explicit_relationships items, relation_type MUST come from the supplied relation_types list.
For supporting_source_spans items, cite the exact quotes that cover the support.

response_contract.shape: Return ONLY one minified JSON object with exactly these keys: schema_version, case_id, condition, payload_sha256, instructions_sha256, fields.
header_rules: schema_version must be exactly 'phase2k-full-transcript-ablation-intermediate-response-v1'.
case_id and condition must copy the payload values exactly.
payload_sha256 and instructions_sha256 must copy the payload hashes exactly.
fields_rules: fields must contain exactly these keys: actors_entities, reference_bindings, abilities_resources, events_actions, states, conditions, recommended_advice, consequences_outcomes, explicit_relationships, uncertainty_unresolved, supporting_source_spans.
Each field value is a possibly-empty array of item objects.

Every item object has exactly the keys: extraction_text (non-empty string, max 2000 chars), resolution_status (one of literal_explicit, context_resolved, vocabulary_supported, unresolved), source_references (non-empty array).
Every source_reference object has exactly the keys: quote (non-empty exact substring of the condition source), occurrence_index (integer >= 0).

Items in the explicit_relationships field additionally have exactly one more key: relation_type (one of ACTOR, TARGET, USES, AFFECTS, CAUSES, ENABLES, PREVENTS, REQUIRES, CONDITION, RESULT, BEFORE, AFTER, UNTIL, NEGATES, REFERS_TO).

champion_abilities.description: Olaf throws an axe into the ground at a target location, dealing damage to enemies it passes through and reducing their Armor and Move Speed. If Olaf picks up the axe, the ability's cooldown is reset.

champion_abilities.name: Ragnarok
champion_abilities.description: Olaf passively gains increased armor and magic resist. He can activate this ability to become immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking.

champion_abilities.name: Tough It Out
champion_abilities.description: Olaf's Attack Speed is increased and he gains a Shield.

champion_abilities.name: Bola Strike
champion_abilities.description:
Rengar throws a bola, slowing the first target hit for a short duration.

Ferocity effect: roots the target.

champion_abilities.name: Unseen Predator
champion_abilities.description:
While in Brush, Rengar leaps at his target with his basic attack.

Rengar generates Ferocity whenever he casts an ability. At Max Ferocity, his next ability is empowered.

Killing enemy champions awards trophies on Rengar's Bonetooth Necklace, granting bonus attack damage.

champion_abilities.name: Savagery
champion_abilities.description:
Rengar's next Attack brutally stabs his target for bonus damage.

Ferocity effect: deals increased damage and grants Attack Speed.

champion_abilities.name: Thrill of the Hunt
champion_abilities.description: Rengar's predatory instincts take over, <font color='#cd90ee'>Camouflaging</font> him and revealing the nearest enemy champion in a large radius around him. During Thrill of the Hunt, Rengar gains Move Speed and he can leap to the tracked enemy without being in brush, reducing their armor.

champion_abilities.name: Battle Roar
champion_abilities.description:
Rengar lets out a battle roar, damaging enemies and healing for some of the recent damage he has taken.

Ferocity effect: additionally breaks crowd control effects.

champion_abilities.name: Assassin's Path
champion_abilities.description: Talon vaults over any terrain or structure, up to a max distance. This ability has a low cooldown, but puts the used terrain on a long cooldown.

champion_abilities.name: Blade's End
champion_abilities.description: Talon's spells Wound champions and large monsters, stacking up to 3 times. When Talon attacks a champion with 3 stacks of Wound, they bleed for heavy damage over time.

champion_abilities.name: Noxian Diplomacy
champion_abilities.description: Talon stabs the target unit. If they are within melee range, this attack deals critical damage. If they are outside melee range, Talon will leap at his target before stabbing them. Talon refunds some health and cooldown if this ability kills the target.

champion_abilities.name: Shadow Assault
champion_abilities.description: Talon disperses a ring of blades and becomes Invisible while gaining additional Move Speed. When Talon emerges from Invisibility, the blades converge on his location. Each time the blades move, Shadow Assault deals physical damage to enemies hit by at least one blade.

champion_abilities.name: Rake
champion_abilities.description: Talon sends out a volley of daggers that then return back to him, dealing physical damage every time it passes through an enemy. The returning blades deal bonus damage and slow units hit.

champion_abilities.name: Hail of Arrows
champion_abilities.description: Varus fires a hail of arrows that deal physical damage and desecrate the ground. Desecrated ground slows enemies' Move Speed and reduces their self healing and regeneration.

champion_abilities.name: Living Vengeance
champion_abilities.description: On kill or assist, Varus temporarily gains Attack Damage and Ability Power. This bonus is larger if the enemy is a champion.

champion_abilities.name: Piercing Arrow
champion_abilities.description: Varus readies and then fires a powerful shot that gains extra range and damage the longer he spends preparing to fire.

champion_abilities.name: Chain of Corruption
champion_abilities.description: Varus flings out a damaging tendril of corruption that immobilizes the first enemy champion hit and then spreads towards nearby uninfected champions, immobilizing them too on contact.

champion_abilities.name: Blighted Quiver
champion_abilities.description: Passive: Varus' basic attacks deal bonus magic damage and apply Blight. Varus' other abilities detonate Blight, dealing magic damage based on the target's maximum Health. Active: Varus empowers his next Piercing Arrow.

lexical_vocabulary.purpose: Bounded League of Legends lexical snapshot used only as Pass 1 mechanical-cleanup hints (ability keys, common summoner spells, basic domain tokens, and explicit champion alias spelling rules). It is intentionally not a semantic ontology and carries no ownership or champion-binding information; champion alias rules are lexical spelling data only and never produce entities, bindings, events, or relations.
lexical_vocabulary.scope_note: No ownership inference, no champion/role/motif classification, no champion binding, and no strategic abstraction. Champion alias hints are deterministic exact word-boundary spelling hints; guarded aliases require champion-shaped local syntax, metadata-licensed aliases require the supplied metadata value, and the never/uncertainty-only list must never be auto-repaired. Hints may only disambiguate local ASR surface forms in Pass 1 text restoration.

direct.note: Capital-initial Kale surfaces are unconditional Kayle hints; lowercase 'kale' (grocery/vegetable usage) is never eligible. The capitalization guard is documented and encoded in this rule.

metadata_licensed.note: Only eligible when the supplied champion metadata contains Darius; never inferred globally because Varus is a competing lexical possibility.

never.note: Soie is never an automatic Zoe repair; it may only be recorded as a DOMAIN_TOKEN_UNCERTAIN uncertainty with Zoe among the alternatives.

champion_abilities.name: Shuriken Flip
champion_abilities.description: Flip backward and fire a shuriken forward, dealing magic damage. The first enemy or smoke cloud hit is marked. Re-cast to dash to the marked target, dealing additional damage.

champion_abilities.name: Assassin's Mark
champion_abilities.description: Dealing spell damage to a champion creates a ring of energy around them. Exiting that ring empowers Akali's next Attack with bonus range and damage.

champion_abilities.name: Five Point Strike
champion_abilities.description: Akali throws out five kunai, dealing damage based on her bonus Attack Damage and Ability Power and slowing.

champion_abilities.name: Perfect Execution
champion_abilities.description: Akali leaps in a direction, damaging enemies she strikes. Re-cast: Akali dashes in a direction, executing all enemies she strikes.

champion_abilities.name: Twilight Shroud
champion_abilities.description: Akali drops a cover of smoke and briefly gains Move Speed. While inside the shroud, Akali becomes invisible and unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks. Attacking or using abilities will briefly reveal her.

champion_abilities.name: Tantrum
champion_abilities.description: Permanently reduces the physical damage Amumu would take. Amumu can unleash his rage, dealing damage to surrounding enemies. Each time Amumu is hit, the cooldown on Tantrum is reduced.

champion_abilities.name: Cursed Touch
champion_abilities.description: Amumu's basic attacks <font color='#9b0f5f'>Curse</font> his enemies, causing them to take bonus true damage from incoming magic damage.

champion_abilities.name: Bandage Toss
champion_abilities.description: Amumu tosses a sticky bandage at a target, stunning and damaging the target while he pulls himself to them.

champion_abilities.name: Curse of the Sad Mummy
champion_abilities.description: Amumu entangles surrounding enemy units in bandages, applying his <keywordMajor>Curse</keywordMajor>, damaging and stunning them.

champion_abilities.name: Despair
champion_abilities.description: Overcome by anguish, nearby enemies lose a percentage of their maximum Health each second and have their <font color='#9b0f5f'>Curses</font> refreshed.

champion_abilities.name: The Weirding
champion_abilities.description: Aurora converges the realms, sending out a blast of spirit magic that damages and slows enemies before Aurora hops backward to safety.

champion_abilities.name: Spirit Abjuration
champion_abilities.description: Aurora's spells and attacks exorcise spirits from the enemies she damages. Exorcised spirits follow Aurora around and heal her.

champion_abilities.name: Twofold Hex
champion_abilities.description: Aurora sends out a missile that curses any enemies it hits. She can then recast the ability to draw active curses back toward herself, damaging foes who are hit along the way.

champion_abilities.name: Between Worlds
champion_abilities.description: Aurora leaps in a direction of her choosing, releasing a shockwave that damages and slows any enemies it hits. Afterward, she creates an area that slows enemies within it and allows Aurora to teleport from one side of the area to the other.

champion_abilities.name: Across the Veil
champion_abilities.description: Aurora leaps in a direction of her choosing, entering the spirit realm upon landing, becoming invisible, and gaining Move Speed for a short duration of time.

champion_abilities.name: Power Fist
champion_abilities.description: Blitzcrank charges up their fist to make the next attack deal double damage and pop their target up in the air.

champion_abilities.name: Mana Barrier
champion_abilities.description: Blitzcrank gains a shield based on their mana when dropping to low health.

champion_abilities.name: Rocket Grab
champion_abilities.description: Blitzcrank fires their right hand to grab an opponent on its path, dealing damage and dragging it back to them.

champion_abilities.name: Static Field
champion_abilities.description: Enemies attacked by Blitzcrank are marked and take lightning damage after 1 second. Additionally, Blitzcrank can activate this ability to remove nearby enemies' shields, damage them, and silence them briefly.

champion_abilities.name: Overdrive
champion_abilities.description: Blitzcrank super charges themself to get dramatically increased Move and Attack Speed. They are temporarily slowed after the effect ends.

champion_abilities.name: Apprehend
champion_abilities.description: Darius hones his axe, passively causing his physical damage to ignore a percentage of his target's Armor. When activated, Darius sweeps up his enemies with his axe's hook and pulls them to him.

champion_abilities.name: Hemorrhage
champion_abilities.description: Darius' attacks and damaging abilities cause enemies to bleed for physical damage over 5 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. Darius enrages and gains massive Attack Damage when his target reaches max stacks.

champion_abilities.name: Decimate
champion_abilities.description: Darius winds up and swings his axe in a wide circle. Enemies struck by the blade take more damage than those struck by the handle. Darius heals based on enemy champions and large monsters hit by the blade.

champion_abilities.name: Noxian Guillotine
champion_abilities.description: Darius leaps to an enemy champion and strikes a lethal blow, dealing true damage. This damage is increased for each stack of Hemorrhage on the target. If Noxian Guillotine is a killing blow, its cooldown is refreshed for a brief duration.

champion_abilities.name: Crippling Strike
champion_abilities.description: Darius's next attack strikes an enemy's crucial artery. As they bleed out, their Move Speed is slowed.

champion_abilities.name: Stand Aside
champion_abilities.description: Draven throws his axes, dealing physical damage to targets hit and knocking them aside. Targets hit are slowed.

champion_abilities.name: League of Draven
champion_abilities.description: Draven gains his fans' Adoration when he catches a Spinning Axe or kills a minion, monster, or tower. Killing enemy champions grants Draven bonus gold based on how much Adoration he has.

champion_abilities.name: Spinning Axe
champion_abilities.description: Draven's next attack will deal bonus physical damage. This axe will ricochet off the target high up into the air. If Draven catches it, he automatically readies another Spinning Axe. Draven can have two Spinning Axes at once.

champion_abilities.name: Whirling Death
champion_abilities.description: Draven hurls two massive axes to deal physical damage to each unit struck. Whirling Death slowly reverses direction and returns to Draven after striking an enemy champion. Draven may also activate this ability while the axes are in flight to cause it to return early. Deals less damage for each unit hit and resets when the axes reverse direction. Executes enemies who have less health than Draven's number of Adoration stacks.

champion_abilities.name: Blood Rush
champion_abilities.description: Draven gains increased Move Speed and Attack Speed. The Move Speed bonus decreases rapidly over its duration. Catching a Spinning Axe will refresh the cooldown of Blood Rush.

champion_abilities.name: Bladework
champion_abilities.description: Fiora has increased attack speed for the next two attacks. The first attack slows the target, and the second attack will critically strike.

champion_abilities.name: Duelist's Dance
champion_abilities.description: Fiora has revealed a <keywordMajor>Vital</keywordMajor> on this Champion. If she hits the <keywordMajor>Vital</keywordMajor>, she <healing>restores Health</healing> and gains <speed>Move Speed</speed>.

champion_abilities.name: Lunge
champion_abilities.description: Fiora lunges in a direction and stabs a nearby enemy, dealing physical damage and applying on-hit effects.

champion_abilities.name: Grand Challenge
champion_abilities.description: Fiora reveals all four Vitals on an enemy champion and gains Move Speed while near them. If Fiora hits all four Vitals or if the target dies after she has hit at least one, Fiora and her allies in the area are healed over the next few seconds.

champion_abilities.name: Riposte
champion_abilities.description: Fiora parries all incoming damage and disables for a short time, then stabs in a direction. This stab slows the first enemy champion hit, or stuns them if Fiora blocked an immobilizing effect with this ability.

champion_abilities.name: Body Slam
champion_abilities.description: Gragas charges to a location and collides with the first enemy unit he comes across, dealing damage to all nearby enemy units and stunning them.

champion_abilities.name: Happy Hour
champion_abilities.description: Gragas periodically heals upon using a skill.

champion_abilities.name: Barrel Roll
champion_abilities.description: Gragas rolls his cask to a location, which can be activated to explode or will explode on its own after 4 seconds. The potency of the explosion increases over time. Enemies struck by the blast have their Move Speed slowed.

champion_abilities.name: Explosive Cask
champion_abilities.description: Gragas hurls his cask to a location, dealing damage and knocking back enemies caught in the blast radius.

champion_abilities.name: Drunken Rage
champion_abilities.description: Gragas samples his latest brew for 1 second. After finishing, he becomes boisterous and belligerent, dealing magic damage to all nearby enemies on his next basic attack and reducing damage received.

champion_abilities.name: Eye Of The Storm
champion_abilities.description: Janna conjures a defensive gale that shields an ally champion or turret from incoming damage and increases their Attack Damage.

champion_abilities.name: Tailwind
champion_abilities.description:
Janna's allies gain Move Speed moving towards her.

Janna deals a portion of bonus Move Speed as bonus magic damage on hit and with Zephyr.

champion_abilities.name: Howling Gale
champion_abilities.description: By creating a localized change in pressure and temperature, Janna is able to create a small storm that grows in size with time. She can activate the spell again to release the storm. On release this storm will fly towards the direction it was cast in, dealing damage and knocking away any enemies in its path.

champion_abilities.name: Monsoon
champion_abilities.description: Janna surrounds herself in a magical storm, throwing enemies back. After the storm has settled, soothing winds heal nearby allies while the ability is active.

champion_abilities.name: Zephyr
champion_abilities.description: Janna summons an air elemental that passively increases her Move Speed and enables her to pass through units. She may also activate this ability to deal damage and slow an enemy's Move Speed.

champion_abilities.name: Counter Strike
champion_abilities.description: Jax's combat prowess allows him to dodge all incoming attacks for a short duration and then quickly counterattack, stunning all surrounding enemies.

champion_abilities.name: Relentless Assault
champion_abilities.description: Jax's consecutive basic attacks continuously increase his Attack Speed.

champion_abilities.name: Leap Strike
champion_abilities.description: Jax leaps toward a unit. If they are an enemy, he strikes them with his weapon.

champion_abilities.name: Grandmaster-at-Arms
champion_abilities.description: Every third consecutive attack deals additional Magic Damage. Additionally, Jax can activate this ability to deal damage around himself and strengthen his resolve, increasing his Armor and Magic Resist for a short duration.

champion_abilities.name: Empower
champion_abilities.description: Jax charges his weapon with energy, causing his next attack to deal additional damage.

champion_abilities.name: Flame Chompers!
champion_abilities.description: Jinx throws out a line of snare grenades that explode after 5 seconds, lighting enemies on fire. Flame Chompers will bite enemy champions who walk over them, rooting them in place.

champion_abilities.name: Get Excited!
champion_abilities.description: Jinx receives massively increased Move Speed and Attack Speed whenever she helps kill or destroy an enemy champions epic jungle monster, or structure.

champion_abilities.name: Switcheroo!
champion_abilities.description: Jinx modifies her basic attacks by swapping between Pow-Pow, her minigun and Fishbones, her rocket launcher. Attacks with Pow-Pow grant Attack Speed, while attacks with Fishbones deal area of effect damage, gain increased range, but drain Mana and attack slower.

champion_abilities.name: Super Mega Death Rocket!
champion_abilities.description: Jinx fires a super rocket across the map that gains damage as it travels. The rocket will explode upon colliding with an enemy champion, dealing damage to it and surrounding enemies based on their missing Health.

champion_abilities.name: Zap!
champion_abilities.description: Jinx uses Zapper, her shock pistol, to fire a blast that deals damage to the first enemy hit, slowing and revealing it.

champion_abilities.name: Rend
champion_abilities.description: Attacks impale their targets with spears. Activate to rip the spears out, slowing and dealing escalating damage.

champion_abilities.name: Martial Poise
champion_abilities.description: Enter a movement command while winding up Kalista's basic attack or Pierce to lunge a short distance when she launches her attack.

champion_abilities.name: Pierce
champion_abilities.description: Throw a fast moving spear that passes through enemies it kills.

champion_abilities.name: Fate's Call
champion_abilities.description: Kalista teleports the Oathsworn ally to herself. They gain the ability to dash toward a position, knocking enemy champions back.

champion_abilities.name: Sentinel
champion_abilities.description:
Gain bonus damage when Kalista and her Oathsworn strike the same target.

Activate to send a soul to scout out the path, revealing the area in front of it.

champion_abilities.name: Shunpo
champion_abilities.description: Katarina blinks to the target, striking it if its an enemy, or striking the nearest enemy otherwise.

champion_abilities.name: Voracity
champion_abilities.description:
Whenever an enemy champion dies that Katarina has damaged recently, her remaining ability cooldowns are dramatically reduced.

If Katarina picks up a Dagger, she uses it to slash through all nearby enemies, dealing magic damage.

champion_abilities.name: Bouncing Blade
champion_abilities.description: Katarina throws a <font color='#FFF673'>Dagger</font> at the target that then bounces to nearby enemies before ricocheting onto the ground.

champion_abilities.name: Death Lotus
champion_abilities.description: Katarina becomes a flurry of blades, dealing massive magic damage while she channels to the 3 nearest enemy champions.

champion_abilities.name: Preparation
champion_abilities.description: Katarina gains a burst of Move Speed, tossing a <font color='#FFF673'>Dagger</font> into the air directly above herself.

champion_abilities.name: Mounting Dread
champion_abilities.description: Lamb fires a carefully placed shot, slowing the target. If Lamb attacks the target two more times, her third attack instead directs Wolf to pounce on the enemy, savaging them for massive damage.

champion_abilities.name: Mark of the Kindred
champion_abilities.description: Kindred can mark targets to Hunt. Successfully completing a Hunt permanently empowers Kindred's basic abilities. Every 4 hunts completed also increases Kindred's basic attack range.

champion_abilities.name: Dance of Arrows
champion_abilities.description: Kindred tumbles and shoots up to three arrows at nearby targets.

champion_abilities.name: Lamb's Respite
champion_abilities.description: Lamb grants all living things inside a zone a respite from death. Until the effect ends, nothing can die. At the end, units are healed.

champion_abilities.name: Wolf's Frenzy
champion_abilities.description: Wolf enrages and attacks enemies around him.  Lamb passively gains stacks by moving and attacking. When fully charged, Lamb's next attack restores health.

champion_abilities.name: Tempest / Cripple
champion_abilities.description:
Tempest: Lee Sin smashes the ground, sending out a shockwave that deals magic damage and reveals enemy units hit. If Tempest hits an enemy, Lee Sin can cast cripple.
Cripple: Lee Sin cripples nearby enemies damaged by Tempest, reducing their Move Speed. Move Speed recovers gradually over the duration.

champion_abilities.name: Flurry
champion_abilities.description: After Lee Sin uses an ability, his next 2 basic attacks gain Attack Speed and return Energy.

champion_abilities.name: Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike
champion_abilities.description:
Sonic Wave: Lee Sin projects a discordant wave of sound to locate his enemies, dealing physical damage to the first enemy it encounters. If Sonic Wave hits, Lee Sin can cast Resonating Strike for the next 3 seconds.
Resonating Strike: Lee Sin dashes to the enemy hit by Sonic Wave, dealing physical damage based on the target's missing Health.

champion_abilities.name: Dragon's Rage
champion_abilities.description: Lee Sin performs a powerful roundhouse kick launching his target back, dealing physical damage to the target and any enemies they collide with. Enemies the target collides with are knocked into the air for a short duration. This technique was taught to him by Jesse Perring, although Lee Sin does not kick players off the map.

champion_abilities.name: Safeguard / Iron Will
champion_abilities.description:
Safeguard: Lee Sin rushes to target ally, shielding himself from damage. If the ally is a champion, they are also shielded. After using Safeguard, Lee Sin can cast Iron Will.
Iron Will: Lee Sin's intense training allows him to thrive in battle. Lee Sin gains Omnivamp.

champion_abilities.name: Zenith Blade
champion_abilities.description: Leona projects a solar image of her sword, dealing magic damage to all enemies in a line. When the image fades, the last enemy champion struck will be briefly immobilized and Leona will dash to them.

champion_abilities.name: Sunlight
champion_abilities.description: Damaging spells afflict enemies with Sunlight for 1.5 seconds. When allied Champions deal damage to those targets, they consume the Sunlight to deal additional magic damage.

champion_abilities.name: Shield of Daybreak
champion_abilities.description: Leona uses her shield to perform her next basic attack, dealing bonus magic damage and stunning the target.

champion_abilities.name: Solar Flare
champion_abilities.description: Leona calls down a beam of solar energy, dealing damage to enemies in an area. Enemies in the center of the area are stunned, while enemies on the outside are slowed.

champion_abilities.name: Eclipse
champion_abilities.description: Leona raises her shield to gain Damage Reduction, Armor, and Magic Resist. When the duration first ends, if there are nearby enemies, she will deal magic damage to them and prolong the duration of the effect.

champion_abilities.name: Help, Pix!
champion_abilities.description: If cast on an ally, commands Pix to jump to an ally and shield them. He then follows them and aids their attacks. If cast on an enemy, commands Pix to jump to an enemy and damage them. He then follows them and grants you vision of that enemy.

champion_abilities.name: Pix, Faerie Companion
champion_abilities.description: Pix fires magical bolts of energy whenever the champion he's following attacks another enemy unit. These bolts are homing, but can be intercepted by other units.

champion_abilities.name: Glitterlance
champion_abilities.description: Pix and Lulu each fire a bolt of magical energy that damages and heavily slows all enemies it hits.

champion_abilities.name: Wild Growth
champion_abilities.description: Lulu enlarges an ally, knocking nearby enemies into the air and granting the ally a large amount of bonus health. For the next few seconds, that ally gains an aura that slows nearby enemies.

champion_abilities.name: Whimsy
champion_abilities.description: If cast on an ally, grants them Attack Speed and Move Speed for a short time. If cast on an enemy, turns them into an adorable critter that can't attack or cast spells.

champion_abilities.name: Shadow Dash
champion_abilities.description: Shen dashes in a direction, taunting enemies in his path.

champion_abilities.name: Ki Barrier
champion_abilities.description: After casting a spell, Shen gets a shield. Affecting other champions reduces the cooldown of this effect.

champion_abilities.name: Twilight Assault
champion_abilities.description: Shen recalls his spirit blade to attack with it, dealing damage based on the target's max health. The attacks are greatly empowered if it collides with an enemy champion, and all collided enemies are slowed while running away from Shen.

champion_abilities.name: Stand United
champion_abilities.description: Shen shields target allied champion from incoming damage, and soon after teleports to their location.

champion_abilities.name: Spirit's Refuge
champion_abilities.description: Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked.

champion_abilities.name: Pillar of Ice
champion_abilities.description: Trundle creates an ice pillar at target location, becoming impassable terrain and slowing all nearby enemy units.

champion_abilities.name: King's Tribute
champion_abilities.description: When an enemy unit dies near Trundle, he heals for a percent of its maximum Health.

champion_abilities.name: Chomp
champion_abilities.description: Trundle bites his opponent, dealing damage, briefly slowing and sapping some of their Attack Damage.

champion_abilities.name: Subjugate
champion_abilities.description: Trundle immediately steals a percent of his target's Health, Armor and Magic Resistance. Over the next 4 seconds the amount of Health, Armor, and Magic Resistance stolen is doubled.

champion_abilities.name: Frozen Domain
champion_abilities.description: Trundle turns target location into his domain, gaining Attack Speed, Move Speed, and increased healing from all sources while on it.

champion_abilities.name: Disdain
champion_abilities.description: Urgot charges in a direction, shielding himself and trampling non-champion enemies. If he catches an enemy champion, he will stop and hurl them out of his way.

champion_abilities.name: Echoing Flames
champion_abilities.description: Urgot's basic attacks and Purge periodically trigger blasts of flame from his legs, dealing physical damage.

champion_abilities.name: Corrosive Charge
champion_abilities.description: Fires an explosive charge at the target location, dealing physical damage and slowing enemies caught in the explosion.

champion_abilities.name: Fear Beyond Death
champion_abilities.description: Urgot fires a chem-drill that impales the first enemy champion hit. If that champion falls below a health threshold, Urgot judges them weak and can execute them.

champion_abilities.name: Purge
champion_abilities.description: Urgot slows himself while he unloads his weapon on nearby enemies. Prioritizes enemy champions Urgot has recently struck with other abilities and triggers Echoing Flames.

champion_abilities.name: Hail of Arrows
champion_abilities.description: Varus fires a hail of arrows that deal physical damage and desecrate the ground. Desecrated ground slows enemies' Move Speed and reduces their self healing and regeneration.

champion_abilities.name: Living Vengeance
champion_abilities.description: On kill or assist, Varus temporarily gains Attack Damage and Ability Power. This bonus is larger if the enemy is a champion.

champion_abilities.name: Piercing Arrow
champion_abilities.description: Varus readies and then fires a powerful shot that gains extra range and damage the longer he spends preparing to fire.

champion_abilities.name: Chain of Corruption
champion_abilities.description: Varus flings out a damaging tendril of corruption that immobilizes the first enemy champion hit and then spreads towards nearby uninfected champions, immobilizing them too on contact.

champion_abilities.name: Blighted Quiver
champion_abilities.description: Passive: Varus' basic attacks deal bonus magic damage and apply Blight. Varus' other abilities detonate Blight, dealing magic damage based on the target's maximum Health. Active: Varus empowers his next Piercing Arrow.

champion_abilities.name: Primal Howl
champion_abilities.description: Warwick gains damage reduction for 2.5 seconds. At the end, or if re-activated, he howls, causing nearby enemies to flee for 1 second.

champion_abilities.name: Eternal Hunger
champion_abilities.description: Warwick's basic attacks deal bonus magic damage. If Warwick is below 50% health, he heals the same amount. If Warwick is below 25% health, this healing triples.

champion_abilities.name: Jaws of the Beast
champion_abilities.description: Warwick lunges forward and bites his target, dealing damage based on their maximum health and healing for damage dealt.

champion_abilities.name: Infinite Duress
champion_abilities.description: Warwick leaps in a direction (scaling with his bonus Move Speed), suppressing the first champion he collides with for 1.5 seconds.

champion_abilities.name: Blood Hunt
champion_abilities.description: Warwick senses enemies below 50% health, gaining Move Speed toward and attack speed against them. When they fall below 25% health, he frenzies and these bonuses triple.

instructions.role: You are extracting source-grounded semantic information from a League of Legends coaching transcript.
task_rules: Use only information supported by the supplied source material and metadata.
The target passage is marked explicitly; extract meaning FOR THE TARGET PASSAGE.
Resolve pronouns, champion references, and ability ownership only when the supplied material supports the resolution.
Do not invent strategic conclusions that are merely plausible League advice.
Do not normalize results into higher-level strategic concepts such as access, continuity, initiative, beatdown, or conversion unless the coach explicitly states that concept.
Do not repair ASR corruption beyond what the supplied vocabulary and context support; record unrecoverable spans as unresolved.
Preserve uncertainty: use resolution_status 'unresolved' whenever a binding or span cannot be supported.

fields.actors_entities: Champions, players, and other entities the target passage is about. Preserve literal surface names when the source wording is used; mark context-resolved bindings explicitly.
fields.reference_bindings: Every pronoun or reference in the target passage and what it binds to. If a reference cannot be resolved from the supplied material, record it with resolution_status 'unresolved' instead of guessing.
fields.abilities_resources: Ability, summoner spell, item, and resource references, including whose ability each one is when the source supports ownership.
fields.events_actions: Concrete things that happened or were done in the game, as stated or entailed by the source.
fields.states: Game states that hold during the target passage: health, mana, cooldowns, position, wave states, objective states, and similar.
fields.conditions: Explicit or clearly implied conditions under which events, advice, or consequences hold ('if', 'when', 'until', 'unless' content).
fields.recommended_advice: Advice or recommended actions the coach actually gives in the target passage. Do not invent plausible League advice the coach did not state.
fields.consequences_outcomes: Stated or clearly implied consequences and outcomes of events, states, or (non-)compliance with advice.
fields.explicit_relationships: Typed relationships between extracted items using ONLY the supplied relation_types vocabulary. Each relationship must be supported by the source.
fields.uncertainty_unresolved: Spans or bindings the speaker or you are uncertain about, ASR corruptions that cannot be recovered, and references that remain unresolved. Preserving uncertainty is required; resolving it by guessing is forbidden.
fields.supporting_source_spans: The minimal source spans that jointly support the extraction for this target passage.

grounding_rules: Every extracted item must cite at least one source reference.

A source reference is an exact contiguous 'quote' copied byte-for-byte from the condition's supplied source text plus a zero-based 'occurrence_index' counted among all exact non-overlapping substring matches of that quote in the condition source.
Never supply character offsets; deterministic tooling resolves your quotes to ranges.
Condition A source text is the supplied Bronze target passage. Condition B source text is the supplied full transcript.
For explicit_relationships items, relation_type MUST come from the supplied relation_types list.
For supporting_source_spans items, cite the exact quotes that cover the support.

response_contract.shape: Return ONLY one minified JSON object with exactly these keys: schema_version, case_id, condition, payload_sha256, instructions_sha256, fields.
header_rules: schema_version must be exactly 'phase2k-full-transcript-ablation-intermediate-response-v1'.
case_id and condition must copy the payload values exactly.
payload_sha256 and instructions_sha256 must copy the payload hashes exactly.
fields_rules: fields must contain exactly these keys: actors_entities, reference_bindings, abilities_resources, events_actions, states, conditions, recommended_advice, consequences_outcomes, explicit_relationships, uncertainty_unresolved, supporting_source_spans.
Each field value is a possibly-empty array of item objects.

Every item object has exactly the keys: extraction_text (non-empty string, max 2000 chars), resolution_status (one of literal_explicit, context_resolved, vocabulary_supported, unresolved), source_references (non-empty array).
Every source_reference object has exactly the keys: quote (non-empty exact substring of the condition source), occurrence_index (integer >= 0).

Items in the explicit_relationships field additionally have exactly one more key: relation_type (one of ACTOR, TARGET, USES, AFFECTS, CAUSES, ENABLES, PREVENTS, REQUIRES, CONDITION, RESULT, BEFORE, AFTER, UNTIL, NEGATES, REFERS_TO).
