champion_abilities.name: Shuriken Flip
champion_abilities.description: Flip backward and fire a shuriken forward, dealing magic damage. The first enemy or smoke cloud hit is marked. Re-cast to dash to the marked target, dealing additional damage.

champion_abilities.name: Assassin's Mark
champion_abilities.description: Dealing spell damage to a champion creates a ring of energy around them. Exiting that ring empowers Akali's next Attack with bonus range and damage.

champion_abilities.name: Five Point Strike
champion_abilities.description: Akali throws out five kunai, dealing damage based on her bonus Attack Damage and Ability Power and slowing.

champion_abilities.name: Perfect Execution
champion_abilities.description: Akali leaps in a direction, damaging enemies she strikes. Re-cast: Akali dashes in a direction, executing all enemies she strikes.

champion_abilities.name: Twilight Shroud
champion_abilities.description: Akali drops a cover of smoke and briefly gains Move Speed. While inside the shroud, Akali becomes invisible and unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks. Attacking or using abilities will briefly reveal her.

champion_abilities.name: 90 Caliber Net
champion_abilities.description: Caitlyn fires a heavy net to slow her target. The recoil knocks Caitlyn back.

champion_abilities.name: Headshot
champion_abilities.description: Every few basic attacks, or against a target she has trapped or netted, Caitlyn will fire a headshot dealing bonus damage that scales with her critical strike chance. On trapped or netted targets, Caitlyn's Headshot attack range is doubled.

champion_abilities.name: Piltover Peacemaker
champion_abilities.description: Caitlyn revs up her rifle for 1 second to unleash a penetrating shot that deals physical damage (deals less damage to subsequent targets).

champion_abilities.name: Ace in the Hole
champion_abilities.description: Caitlyn takes time to line up the perfect shot, dealing massive damage to a single target at a huge range. Enemy champions can intercept the bullet for their ally.

champion_abilities.name: Yordle Snap Trap
champion_abilities.description: Caitlyn sets a trap that, when sprung, reveals and immobilizes the enemy champion for 1.5 seconds, granting Caitlyn an empowered Headshot.

champion_abilities.name: Gatling Gun
champion_abilities.description: Corki's gatling gun rapidly fires in a cone in front of him, dealing damage and reducing enemy Armor and Magic Resist.

champion_abilities.name: Hextech Munitions
champion_abilities.description: A percentage of Corki's basic attack damage is dealt as bonus <trueDamage>true damage</trueDamage>.

champion_abilities.name: Phosphorus Bomb
champion_abilities.description: Corki fires a flash bomb at a target location, dealing magic damage to enemies in the area. This attack additionally reveals units in the area for a duration.

champion_abilities.name: Missile Barrage
champion_abilities.description: Corki fires a missile toward his target location that explodes on impact, dealing damage to enemies in an area. Corki stores missiles over time, up to a maximum. Every 3rd missile fired will be a Big One, dealing extra damage.

champion_abilities.name: Valkyrie
champion_abilities.description: Corki flies a short distance, dropping bombs that create a trail of fire that damages opponents who remain in it.

champion_abilities.name: Lunar Rush
champion_abilities.description:
Becomes the living embodiment of the vengeful moon, dashing to an enemy and dealing magic damage.

Lunar Rush has no cooldown when used to dash to an enemy afflicted with Moonlight. All other enemies will have the Moonlight debuff removed regardless of whether they were the target of Lunar Rush.

champion_abilities.name: Moonsilver Blade
champion_abilities.description: Every third strike cleaves nearby enemies for an additional magic damage. After casting a spell, Diana gains Attack Speed for 5 seconds.

champion_abilities.name: Crescent Strike
champion_abilities.description:
Unleashes a bolt of lunar energy in an arc dealing magic damage.

Afflicts enemies struck with Moonlight, revealing them if they are not stealthed for 3 seconds.

champion_abilities.name: Moonfall
champion_abilities.description:
Diana reveals and draws in all nearby enemies and slows them.

If Diana pulls in one or more enemy champions, the moonlight crashes down onto her after a short delay, dealing magic damage in an area around her, increased for each target beyond the first pulled.

champion_abilities.name: Pale Cascade
champion_abilities.description: Diana creates three orbiting spheres that detonate on contact with enemies to deal damage in an area. She also gains a temporary shield that absorbs damage. If her third sphere detonates, the shield gains additional strength.

champion_abilities.name: Rend
champion_abilities.description: Attacks impale their targets with spears. Activate to rip the spears out, slowing and dealing escalating damage.

champion_abilities.name: Martial Poise
champion_abilities.description: Enter a movement command while winding up Kalista's basic attack or Pierce to lunge a short distance when she launches her attack.

champion_abilities.name: Pierce
champion_abilities.description: Throw a fast moving spear that passes through enemies it kills.

champion_abilities.name: Fate's Call
champion_abilities.description: Kalista teleports the Oathsworn ally to herself. They gain the ability to dash toward a position, knocking enemy champions back.

champion_abilities.name: Sentinel
champion_abilities.description:
Gain bonus damage when Kalista and her Oathsworn strike the same target.

Activate to send a soul to scout out the path, revealing the area in front of it.

champion_abilities.name: Inspire
champion_abilities.description:
Karma summons a protective shield that absorbs incoming damage and increases the Move Speed of the protected ally.

Mantra Bonus: Energy radiates out from her target, strengthening the initial shield and applying Inspire to nearby allied champions.

champion_abilities.name: Gathering Fire
champion_abilities.description: Karma's damaging abilities will reduce the cooldown of Mantra.

champion_abilities.name: Inner Flame
champion_abilities.description:
Karma sends forth a ball of spirit energy that explodes and deals damage upon hitting an enemy unit.

Mantra Bonus: In addition to the explosion, Mantra increases the destructive power of her Inner Flame, creating a cataclysm which deals damage after a short delay.

champion_abilities.name: Mantra
champion_abilities.description: Karma empowers her next ability to do an additional effect. Mantra is available at level 1 and does not require a skill point.

champion_abilities.name: Focused Resolve
champion_abilities.description:
Karma creates a tether between herself and a targeted enemy, dealing damage and revealing them. If the tether is not broken, the enemy will be rooted and damaged again.

Mantra Bonus: Karma strengthens the link, healing herself and extending the root duration.

champion_abilities.name: Ethereal Chains
champion_abilities.description: LeBlanc launches a chain that shackles the first enemy hit. If the target remains shackled for 1.5 seconds, LeBlanc roots them and deals additional damage.

champion_abilities.name: Mirror Image
champion_abilities.description: When LeBlanc drops below 40% Health, she becomes invisible for 1 second and creates a Mirror Image that deals no damage and lasts for up to 8 seconds.

champion_abilities.name: Sigil of Malice
champion_abilities.description: LeBlanc projects a sigil, dealing damage and marking the target for 3.5 seconds. Damaging the marked target with an ability detonates the sigil, dealing additional damage. If either part kills the target, Leblanc refunds the Mana cost and part of this spell's remaining Cooldown.

champion_abilities.name: Mimic
champion_abilities.description: LeBlanc casts a mimicked version of one of her basic spells.

champion_abilities.name: Distortion
champion_abilities.description: LeBlanc dashes to a location, dealing damage to enemies near her destination. For the next 4 seconds, activate Distortion again to return LeBlanc to her starting location.

champion_abilities.name: Zenith Blade
champion_abilities.description: Leona projects a solar image of her sword, dealing magic damage to all enemies in a line. When the image fades, the last enemy champion struck will be briefly immobilized and Leona will dash to them.

champion_abilities.name: Sunlight
champion_abilities.description: Damaging spells afflict enemies with Sunlight for 1.5 seconds. When allied Champions deal damage to those targets, they consume the Sunlight to deal additional magic damage.

champion_abilities.name: Shield of Daybreak
champion_abilities.description: Leona uses her shield to perform her next basic attack, dealing bonus magic damage and stunning the target.

champion_abilities.name: Solar Flare
champion_abilities.description: Leona calls down a beam of solar energy, dealing damage to enemies in an area. Enemies in the center of the area are stunned, while enemies on the outside are slowed.

champion_abilities.name: Eclipse
champion_abilities.description: Leona raises her shield to gain Damage Reduction, Armor, and Magic Resist. When the duration first ends, if there are nearby enemies, she will deal magic damage to them and prolong the duration of the effect.

champion_abilities.name: Relentless Pursuit
champion_abilities.description: Lucian quickly dashes a short distance. Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown.

champion_abilities.name: Lightslinger
champion_abilities.description: Whenever Lucian uses an ability, his next attack becomes a double-shot. When Lucian is healed or shielded by an ally, or when a nearby enemy Champion is immobilized, his next 2 basic attacks will deal bonus magic damage.

champion_abilities.name: Piercing Light
champion_abilities.description: Lucian shoots a bolt of piercing light through a target.

champion_abilities.name: The Culling
champion_abilities.description: Lucian unleashes a torrent of shots from his weapons.

champion_abilities.name: Ardent Blaze
champion_abilities.description: Lucian shoots a missile that explodes in a star shape, marking and briefly revealing enemies. Lucian gains Move Speed for attacking marked enemies.

champion_abilities.name: Tidecaller's Blessing
champion_abilities.description: Empowers an allied champion for a short duration. The ally's basic attacks and spells deal bonus magic damage and slow the target.

champion_abilities.name: Surging Tides
champion_abilities.description: When Nami's Abilities hit allied champions they gain Move Speed for a short duration.

champion_abilities.name: Aqua Prison
champion_abilities.description: Sends a bubble to a target area, dealing damage and stunning all enemies on impact.

champion_abilities.name: Tidal Wave
champion_abilities.description: Summons a massive Tidal Wave that knocks up, slows, and damages enemies. Allies hit gain double the effect of Surging Tides.

champion_abilities.name: Ebb and Flow
champion_abilities.description: Unleashes a stream of water that bounces back and forth between allied and enemy champions, healing allies and damaging enemies.

champion_abilities.name: Reckless Swing
champion_abilities.description: Olaf attacks with such force that it deals true damage to his target and himself, refunding the Health cost if he destroys the target.

champion_abilities.name: Berserker Rage
champion_abilities.description: Olaf gains Attack Speed and Life Steal based on his missing Health.

champion_abilities.name: Undertow
champion_abilities.description: Olaf throws an axe into the ground at a target location, dealing damage to enemies it passes through and reducing their Armor and Move Speed. If Olaf picks up the axe, the ability's cooldown is reset.

champion_abilities.name: Ragnarok
champion_abilities.description: Olaf passively gains increased armor and magic resist. He can activate this ability to become immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking.

champion_abilities.name: Tough It Out
champion_abilities.description: Olaf's Attack Speed is increased and he gains a Shield.

champion_abilities.name: Flap, Flap, Flap
champion_abilities.description: Smolder takes flight ignoring terrain and bombarding the lowest health enemy.

champion_abilities.name: Dragon Practice
champion_abilities.description: Hitting champions with Abilities and killing enemies with Super Scorcher Breath grants a stack of Dragon Practice. Stacks increase the damage of Smolders basic Abilities.

champion_abilities.name: Super Scorcher Breath
champion_abilities.description: Smolder breathes fire on an enemy. As he gains more stacks, this ability becomes more powerful.

champion_abilities.name: MMOOOMMMM!
champion_abilities.description: Smolder calls his mom to breath fire from above, dealing extra damage and slowing enemies in the center of her fire.

champion_abilities.name: Achooo!
champion_abilities.description: Smolder lets out an adorable flaming sneeze that explodes when hitting enemy champions.

champion_abilities.name: Nevermove
champion_abilities.description: Swain launches a wave of demonic power forward. It then returns to Swain and roots enemies it hits. Swain can then choose to pull all rooted champions closer. This ability has a shorter cooldown during Demonic Ascension.

champion_abilities.name: Ravenous Flock
champion_abilities.description: Swain's ravens collect Soul Fragments that heal him and permanently increase his maximum health.

champion_abilities.name: Death's Hand
champion_abilities.description: Swain unleashes several bolts of eldritch power that pierce through enemies. Enemies hit take more damage for each bolt they are struck by.

champion_abilities.name: Demonic Ascension
champion_abilities.description: Swain transforms into a demon and drains health from nearby enemy champions, minions, and neutral monsters. Swain can cast Demonflare to decimate and slow nearby enemies with a nova of soulfire. This form is indefinite as long as Swain drains enemy champions.

champion_abilities.name: Vision of Empire
champion_abilities.description: Swain opens a demon eye that deals damage and slows enemies. Champions hit are revealed and also grant Swain a Soul Fragment.

champion_abilities.name: Scatter the Weak
champion_abilities.description: Syndra knocks enemies and Dark Spheres back dealing magic damage. Enemies hit by Dark Spheres become stunned.

champion_abilities.name: Transcendent
champion_abilities.description:
Syndra collects Splinters of Wrath from gaining levels and damaging enemies which upgrade her abilities.

Dark Sphere: Syndra can hold an additional charge
Force of Will: Bonus true damage.
Scatter the Weak: Increased width and slows all targets
Unleashed Power: Executes low health targets

champion_abilities.name: Dark Sphere
champion_abilities.description: Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere dealing magic damage. The sphere remains and can be manipulated by her other powers.

champion_abilities.name: Unleashed Power
champion_abilities.description: Syndra bombards an enemy Champion with all of her Dark Spheres.

champion_abilities.name: Force of Will
champion_abilities.description: Syndra picks up and throws a Dark Sphere or enemy minion dealing magic damage and slowing the Move Speed of enemies.

champion_abilities.name: Explosive Charge
champion_abilities.description: When Tristana kills a unit, her cannonballs burst into shrapnel, dealing damage to surrounding enemies. Can be activated to place a bomb on a target enemy that explodes after a short duration dealing damage to surrounding units.

champion_abilities.name: Draw a Bead
champion_abilities.description: Increases Tristana's Attack Range as she levels.

champion_abilities.name: Rapid Fire
champion_abilities.description: Tristana fires her weapon rapidly, increasing her Attack Speed for a short time.

champion_abilities.name: Buster Shot
champion_abilities.description: Tristana loads a massive cannonball into her weapon and fires it at an enemy unit. This deals Magic Damage and knocks the target back. If the target is carrying the Explosive Charge bomb, the bomb detonation radius is doubled.

champion_abilities.name: Rocket Jump
champion_abilities.description: Tristana fires at the ground to propel her to a distant location, dealing damage and slowing surrounding units for a brief period where she lands.

champion_abilities.name: Event Horizon
champion_abilities.description: Veigar twists the edges of space, creating a cage that Stuns enemies that pass through.

champion_abilities.name: Phenomenal Evil Power
champion_abilities.description: Veigar is the greatest Evil to ever strike at the hearts of Runeterra - and he's only getting bigger! Striking an enemy Champion with a spell or scoring a takedown grants Veigar permanently increased Ability Power.

champion_abilities.name: Baleful Strike
champion_abilities.description: Veigar unleashes a bolt of dark energy that deals magic damage to the first two enemies hit. Units killed by this bolt grant Veigar some ability power permanently.

champion_abilities.name: Primordial Burst
champion_abilities.description: Blasts target enemy champion, dealing a large amount of magic damage, increasing based on the target's missing health.

champion_abilities.name: Dark Matter
champion_abilities.description: Veigar calls a great mass of dark matter to fall from the sky to the target location, dealing magic damage when it lands. Stacks of Phenomenal Evil reduce Dark Matter's cooldown.

champion_abilities.name: Looming Darkness
champion_abilities.description: Summon a damaging and slowing zone that applies Gloom to enemies.

champion_abilities.name: Doom 'n Gloom
champion_abilities.description: Vex periodically becomes empowered, causing her next basic Ability to fear enemies and interrupt dashes. Whenever a nearby enemy dashes, Vex applies a mark that can be consumed for bonus damage that also reduces the cooldown of her empowered state.

champion_abilities.name: Mistral Bolt
champion_abilities.description: Launch a damaging missile that accelerates mid-flight.

champion_abilities.name: Shadow Surge
champion_abilities.description: Fire a missile that marks an enemy champion.  Recast to dash to them and deal damage.

champion_abilities.name: Personal Space
champion_abilities.description: Gain a shield and damage nearby enemies.

champion_abilities.name: Nimbus Strike
champion_abilities.description: Wukong dashes to a targeted enemy and sends out images to attack enemies near his target, dealing damage to each enemy struck.

champion_abilities.name: Stone Skin
champion_abilities.description: Wukong gains stacking armor and max health regeneration while fighting champions and monsters.

champion_abilities.name: Crushing Blow
champion_abilities.description: Wukong's next attack gains attack range, deals bonus damage, and reduces the target's armor for a few seconds.

champion_abilities.name: Cyclone
champion_abilities.description:
Wukong's extends his staff and spins it around repeatedly, gaining Move Speed.

Enemies struck take damage and are knocked up.

champion_abilities.name: Warrior Trickster
champion_abilities.description: Wukong becomes <font color='#91d7ee'>Invisible</font> and dashes in a direction, leaving behind a clone that will attack nearby enemies.

instructions.role: You are extracting source-grounded semantic information from a League of Legends coaching transcript.
task_rules: Use only information supported by the supplied source material and metadata.
The target passage is marked explicitly; extract meaning FOR THE TARGET PASSAGE.
Resolve pronouns, champion references, and ability ownership only when the supplied material supports the resolution.
Do not invent strategic conclusions that are merely plausible League advice.
Do not normalize results into higher-level strategic concepts such as access, continuity, initiative, beatdown, or conversion unless the coach explicitly states that concept.
Do not repair ASR corruption beyond what the supplied vocabulary and context support; record unrecoverable spans as unresolved.
Preserve uncertainty: use resolution_status 'unresolved' whenever a binding or span cannot be supported.

fields.actors_entities: Champions, players, and other entities the target passage is about. Preserve literal surface names when the source wording is used; mark context-resolved bindings explicitly.
fields.reference_bindings: Every pronoun or reference in the target passage and what it binds to. If a reference cannot be resolved from the supplied material, record it with resolution_status 'unresolved' instead of guessing.
fields.abilities_resources: Ability, summoner spell, item, and resource references, including whose ability each one is when the source supports ownership.
fields.events_actions: Concrete things that happened or were done in the game, as stated or entailed by the source.
fields.states: Game states that hold during the target passage: health, mana, cooldowns, position, wave states, objective states, and similar.
fields.conditions: Explicit or clearly implied conditions under which events, advice, or consequences hold ('if', 'when', 'until', 'unless' content).
fields.recommended_advice: Advice or recommended actions the coach actually gives in the target passage. Do not invent plausible League advice the coach did not state.
fields.consequences_outcomes: Stated or clearly implied consequences and outcomes of events, states, or (non-)compliance with advice.
fields.explicit_relationships: Typed relationships between extracted items using ONLY the supplied relation_types vocabulary. Each relationship must be supported by the source.
fields.uncertainty_unresolved: Spans or bindings the speaker or you are uncertain about, ASR corruptions that cannot be recovered, and references that remain unresolved. Preserving uncertainty is required; resolving it by guessing is forbidden.
fields.supporting_source_spans: The minimal source spans that jointly support the extraction for this target passage.

grounding_rules: Every extracted item must cite at least one source reference.

A source reference is an exact contiguous 'quote' copied byte-for-byte from the condition's supplied source text plus a zero-based 'occurrence_index' counted among all exact non-overlapping substring matches of that quote in the condition source.
Never supply character offsets; deterministic tooling resolves your quotes to ranges.
Condition A source text is the supplied Bronze target passage. Condition B source text is the supplied full transcript.
For explicit_relationships items, relation_type MUST come from the supplied relation_types list.
For supporting_source_spans items, cite the exact quotes that cover the support.

response_contract.shape: Return ONLY one minified JSON object with exactly these keys: schema_version, case_id, condition, payload_sha256, instructions_sha256, fields.
header_rules: schema_version must be exactly 'phase2k-full-transcript-ablation-intermediate-response-v1'.
case_id and condition must copy the payload values exactly.
payload_sha256 and instructions_sha256 must copy the payload hashes exactly.
fields_rules: fields must contain exactly these keys: actors_entities, reference_bindings, abilities_resources, events_actions, states, conditions, recommended_advice, consequences_outcomes, explicit_relationships, uncertainty_unresolved, supporting_source_spans.
Each field value is a possibly-empty array of item objects.

Every item object has exactly the keys: extraction_text (non-empty string, max 2000 chars), resolution_status (one of literal_explicit, context_resolved, vocabulary_supported, unresolved), source_references (non-empty array).
Every source_reference object has exactly the keys: quote (non-empty exact substring of the condition source), occurrence_index (integer >= 0).

Items in the explicit_relationships field additionally have exactly one more key: relation_type (one of ACTOR, TARGET, USES, AFFECTS, CAUSES, ENABLES, PREVENTS, REQUIRES, CONDITION, RESULT, BEFORE, AFTER, UNTIL, NEGATES, REFERS_TO).

champion_abilities.description: Enter a movement command while winding up Kalista's basic attack or Pierce to lunge a short distance when she launches her attack.

champion_abilities.name: Pierce
champion_abilities.description: Throw a fast moving spear that passes through enemies it kills.

champion_abilities.name: Fate's Call
champion_abilities.description: Kalista teleports the Oathsworn ally to herself. They gain the ability to dash toward a position, knocking enemy champions back.

champion_abilities.name: Sentinel
champion_abilities.description:
Gain bonus damage when Kalista and her Oathsworn strike the same target.

Activate to send a soul to scout out the path, revealing the area in front of it.

champion_abilities.name: Inspire
champion_abilities.description:
Karma summons a protective shield that absorbs incoming damage and increases the Move Speed of the protected ally.

Mantra Bonus: Energy radiates out from her target, strengthening the initial shield and applying Inspire to nearby allied champions.

champion_abilities.name: Gathering Fire
champion_abilities.description: Karma's damaging abilities will reduce the cooldown of Mantra.

champion_abilities.name: Inner Flame
champion_abilities.description:
Karma sends forth a ball of spirit energy that explodes and deals damage upon hitting an enemy unit.

Mantra Bonus: In addition to the explosion, Mantra increases the destructive power of her Inner Flame, creating a cataclysm which deals damage after a short delay.

champion_abilities.name: Mantra
champion_abilities.description: Karma empowers her next ability to do an additional effect. Mantra is available at level 1 and does not require a skill point.

champion_abilities.name: Focused Resolve
champion_abilities.description:
Karma creates a tether between herself and a targeted enemy, dealing damage and revealing them. If the tether is not broken, the enemy will be rooted and damaged again.

Mantra Bonus: Karma strengthens the link, healing herself and extending the root duration.

champion_abilities.name: Ethereal Chains
champion_abilities.description: LeBlanc launches a chain that shackles the first enemy hit. If the target remains shackled for 1.5 seconds, LeBlanc roots them and deals additional damage.

champion_abilities.name: Mirror Image
champion_abilities.description: When LeBlanc drops below 40% Health, she becomes invisible for 1 second and creates a Mirror Image that deals no damage and lasts for up to 8 seconds.

champion_abilities.name: Sigil of Malice
champion_abilities.description: LeBlanc projects a sigil, dealing damage and marking the target for 3.5 seconds. Damaging the marked target with an ability detonates the sigil, dealing additional damage. If either part kills the target, Leblanc refunds the Mana cost and part of this spell's remaining Cooldown.

champion_abilities.name: Mimic
champion_abilities.description: LeBlanc casts a mimicked version of one of her basic spells.

champion_abilities.name: Distortion
champion_abilities.description: LeBlanc dashes to a location, dealing damage to enemies near her destination. For the next 4 seconds, activate Distortion again to return LeBlanc to her starting location.

champion_abilities.name: Zenith Blade
champion_abilities.description: Leona projects a solar image of her sword, dealing magic damage to all enemies in a line. When the image fades, the last enemy champion struck will be briefly immobilized and Leona will dash to them.

champion_abilities.name: Sunlight
champion_abilities.description: Damaging spells afflict enemies with Sunlight for 1.5 seconds. When allied Champions deal damage to those targets, they consume the Sunlight to deal additional magic damage.

champion_abilities.name: Shield of Daybreak
champion_abilities.description: Leona uses her shield to perform her next basic attack, dealing bonus magic damage and stunning the target.

champion_abilities.name: Solar Flare
champion_abilities.description: Leona calls down a beam of solar energy, dealing damage to enemies in an area. Enemies in the center of the area are stunned, while enemies on the outside are slowed.

champion_abilities.name: Eclipse
champion_abilities.description: Leona raises her shield to gain Damage Reduction, Armor, and Magic Resist. When the duration first ends, if there are nearby enemies, she will deal magic damage to them and prolong the duration of the effect.

champion_abilities.name: Relentless Pursuit
champion_abilities.description: Lucian quickly dashes a short distance. Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown.

champion_abilities.name: Lightslinger
champion_abilities.description: Whenever Lucian uses an ability, his next attack becomes a double-shot. When Lucian is healed or shielded by an ally, or when a nearby enemy Champion is immobilized, his next 2 basic attacks will deal bonus magic damage.

champion_abilities.name: Piercing Light
champion_abilities.description: Lucian shoots a bolt of piercing light through a target.

champion_abilities.name: The Culling
champion_abilities.description: Lucian unleashes a torrent of shots from his weapons.

champion_abilities.name: Ardent Blaze
champion_abilities.description: Lucian shoots a missile that explodes in a star shape, marking and briefly revealing enemies. Lucian gains Move Speed for attacking marked enemies.

champion_abilities.name: Tidecaller's Blessing
champion_abilities.description: Empowers an allied champion for a short duration. The ally's basic attacks and spells deal bonus magic damage and slow the target.

champion_abilities.name: Surging Tides
champion_abilities.description: When Nami's Abilities hit allied champions they gain Move Speed for a short duration.

champion_abilities.name: Aqua Prison
champion_abilities.description: Sends a bubble to a target area, dealing damage and stunning all enemies on impact.

champion_abilities.name: Tidal Wave
champion_abilities.description: Summons a massive Tidal Wave that knocks up, slows, and damages enemies. Allies hit gain double the effect of Surging Tides.

champion_abilities.name: Ebb and Flow
champion_abilities.description: Unleashes a stream of water that bounces back and forth between allied and enemy champions, healing allies and damaging enemies.

champion_abilities.name: Reckless Swing
champion_abilities.description: Olaf attacks with such force that it deals true damage to his target and himself, refunding the Health cost if he destroys the target.

champion_abilities.name: Berserker Rage
champion_abilities.description: Olaf gains Attack Speed and Life Steal based on his missing Health.

champion_abilities.name: Undertow
champion_abilities.description: Olaf throws an axe into the ground at a target location, dealing damage to enemies it passes through and reducing their Armor and Move Speed. If Olaf picks up the axe, the ability's cooldown is reset.

champion_abilities.name: Ragnarok
champion_abilities.description: Olaf passively gains increased armor and magic resist. He can activate this ability to become immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking.

champion_abilities.name: Tough It Out
champion_abilities.description: Olaf's Attack Speed is increased and he gains a Shield.

champion_abilities.name: Flap, Flap, Flap
champion_abilities.description: Smolder takes flight ignoring terrain and bombarding the lowest health enemy.

champion_abilities.name: Dragon Practice
champion_abilities.description: Hitting champions with Abilities and killing enemies with Super Scorcher Breath grants a stack of Dragon Practice. Stacks increase the damage of Smolders basic Abilities.

champion_abilities.name: Super Scorcher Breath
champion_abilities.description: Smolder breathes fire on an enemy. As he gains more stacks, this ability becomes more powerful.

champion_abilities.name: MMOOOMMMM!
champion_abilities.description: Smolder calls his mom to breath fire from above, dealing extra damage and slowing enemies in the center of her fire.

champion_abilities.name: Achooo!
champion_abilities.description: Smolder lets out an adorable flaming sneeze that explodes when hitting enemy champions.

champion_abilities.name: Nevermove
champion_abilities.description: Swain launches a wave of demonic power forward. It then returns to Swain and roots enemies it hits. Swain can then choose to pull all rooted champions closer. This ability has a shorter cooldown during Demonic Ascension.

champion_abilities.name: Ravenous Flock
champion_abilities.description: Swain's ravens collect Soul Fragments that heal him and permanently increase his maximum health.

champion_abilities.name: Death's Hand
champion_abilities.description: Swain unleashes several bolts of eldritch power that pierce through enemies. Enemies hit take more damage for each bolt they are struck by.

champion_abilities.name: Demonic Ascension
champion_abilities.description: Swain transforms into a demon and drains health from nearby enemy champions, minions, and neutral monsters. Swain can cast Demonflare to decimate and slow nearby enemies with a nova of soulfire. This form is indefinite as long as Swain drains enemy champions.

champion_abilities.name: Vision of Empire
champion_abilities.description: Swain opens a demon eye that deals damage and slows enemies. Champions hit are revealed and also grant Swain a Soul Fragment.

champion_abilities.name: Scatter the Weak
champion_abilities.description: Syndra knocks enemies and Dark Spheres back dealing magic damage. Enemies hit by Dark Spheres become stunned.

champion_abilities.name: Transcendent
champion_abilities.description:
Syndra collects Splinters of Wrath from gaining levels and damaging enemies which upgrade her abilities.

Dark Sphere: Syndra can hold an additional charge
Force of Will: Bonus true damage.
Scatter the Weak: Increased width and slows all targets
Unleashed Power: Executes low health targets

champion_abilities.name: Dark Sphere
champion_abilities.description: Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere dealing magic damage. The sphere remains and can be manipulated by her other powers.

champion_abilities.name: Unleashed Power
champion_abilities.description: Syndra bombards an enemy Champion with all of her Dark Spheres.

champion_abilities.name: Force of Will
champion_abilities.description: Syndra picks up and throws a Dark Sphere or enemy minion dealing magic damage and slowing the Move Speed of enemies.

champion_abilities.name: Explosive Charge
champion_abilities.description: When Tristana kills a unit, her cannonballs burst into shrapnel, dealing damage to surrounding enemies. Can be activated to place a bomb on a target enemy that explodes after a short duration dealing damage to surrounding units.

champion_abilities.name: Draw a Bead
champion_abilities.description: Increases Tristana's Attack Range as she levels.

champion_abilities.name: Rapid Fire
champion_abilities.description: Tristana fires her weapon rapidly, increasing her Attack Speed for a short time.

champion_abilities.name: Buster Shot
champion_abilities.description: Tristana loads a massive cannonball into her weapon and fires it at an enemy unit. This deals Magic Damage and knocks the target back. If the target is carrying the Explosive Charge bomb, the bomb detonation radius is doubled.

champion_abilities.name: Rocket Jump
champion_abilities.description: Tristana fires at the ground to propel her to a distant location, dealing damage and slowing surrounding units for a brief period where she lands.

champion_abilities.name: Event Horizon
champion_abilities.description: Veigar twists the edges of space, creating a cage that Stuns enemies that pass through.

champion_abilities.name: Phenomenal Evil Power
champion_abilities.description: Veigar is the greatest Evil to ever strike at the hearts of Runeterra - and he's only getting bigger! Striking an enemy Champion with a spell or scoring a takedown grants Veigar permanently increased Ability Power.

champion_abilities.name: Baleful Strike
champion_abilities.description: Veigar unleashes a bolt of dark energy that deals magic damage to the first two enemies hit. Units killed by this bolt grant Veigar some ability power permanently.

champion_abilities.name: Primordial Burst
champion_abilities.description: Blasts target enemy champion, dealing a large amount of magic damage, increasing based on the target's missing health.

champion_abilities.name: Dark Matter
champion_abilities.description: Veigar calls a great mass of dark matter to fall from the sky to the target location, dealing magic damage when it lands. Stacks of Phenomenal Evil reduce Dark Matter's cooldown.

champion_abilities.name: Looming Darkness
champion_abilities.description: Summon a damaging and slowing zone that applies Gloom to enemies.

champion_abilities.name: Doom 'n Gloom
champion_abilities.description: Vex periodically becomes empowered, causing her next basic Ability to fear enemies and interrupt dashes. Whenever a nearby enemy dashes, Vex applies a mark that can be consumed for bonus damage that also reduces the cooldown of her empowered state.

champion_abilities.name: Mistral Bolt
champion_abilities.description: Launch a damaging missile that accelerates mid-flight.

champion_abilities.name: Shadow Surge
champion_abilities.description: Fire a missile that marks an enemy champion.  Recast to dash to them and deal damage.

champion_abilities.name: Personal Space
champion_abilities.description: Gain a shield and damage nearby enemies.

champion_abilities.name: Nimbus Strike
champion_abilities.description: Wukong dashes to a targeted enemy and sends out images to attack enemies near his target, dealing damage to each enemy struck.

champion_abilities.name: Stone Skin
champion_abilities.description: Wukong gains stacking armor and max health regeneration while fighting champions and monsters.

champion_abilities.name: Crushing Blow
champion_abilities.description: Wukong's next attack gains attack range, deals bonus damage, and reduces the target's armor for a few seconds.

champion_abilities.name: Cyclone
champion_abilities.description:
Wukong's extends his staff and spins it around repeatedly, gaining Move Speed.

Enemies struck take damage and are knocked up.

champion_abilities.name: Warrior Trickster
champion_abilities.description: Wukong becomes <font color='#91d7ee'>Invisible</font> and dashes in a direction, leaving behind a clone that will attack nearby enemies.

instructions.role: You are extracting source-grounded semantic information from a League of Legends coaching transcript.
task_rules: Use only information supported by the supplied source material and metadata.
The target passage is marked explicitly; extract meaning FOR THE TARGET PASSAGE.
Resolve pronouns, champion references, and ability ownership only when the supplied material supports the resolution.
Do not invent strategic conclusions that are merely plausible League advice.
Do not normalize results into higher-level strategic concepts such as access, continuity, initiative, beatdown, or conversion unless the coach explicitly states that concept.
Do not repair ASR corruption beyond what the supplied vocabulary and context support; record unrecoverable spans as unresolved.
Preserve uncertainty: use resolution_status 'unresolved' whenever a binding or span cannot be supported.

fields.actors_entities: Champions, players, and other entities the target passage is about. Preserve literal surface names when the source wording is used; mark context-resolved bindings explicitly.
fields.reference_bindings: Every pronoun or reference in the target passage and what it binds to. If a reference cannot be resolved from the supplied material, record it with resolution_status 'unresolved' instead of guessing.
fields.abilities_resources: Ability, summoner spell, item, and resource references, including whose ability each one is when the source supports ownership.
fields.events_actions: Concrete things that happened or were done in the game, as stated or entailed by the source.
fields.states: Game states that hold during the target passage: health, mana, cooldowns, position, wave states, objective states, and similar.
fields.conditions: Explicit or clearly implied conditions under which events, advice, or consequences hold ('if', 'when', 'until', 'unless' content).
fields.recommended_advice: Advice or recommended actions the coach actually gives in the target passage. Do not invent plausible League advice the coach did not state.
fields.consequences_outcomes: Stated or clearly implied consequences and outcomes of events, states, or (non-)compliance with advice.
fields.explicit_relationships: Typed relationships between extracted items using ONLY the supplied relation_types vocabulary. Each relationship must be supported by the source.
fields.uncertainty_unresolved: Spans or bindings the speaker or you are uncertain about, ASR corruptions that cannot be recovered, and references that remain unresolved. Preserving uncertainty is required; resolving it by guessing is forbidden.
fields.supporting_source_spans: The minimal source spans that jointly support the extraction for this target passage.

grounding_rules: Every extracted item must cite at least one source reference.

A source reference is an exact contiguous 'quote' copied byte-for-byte from the condition's supplied source text plus a zero-based 'occurrence_index' counted among all exact non-overlapping substring matches of that quote in the condition source.
Never supply character offsets; deterministic tooling resolves your quotes to ranges.
Condition A source text is the supplied Bronze target passage. Condition B source text is the supplied full transcript.
For explicit_relationships items, relation_type MUST come from the supplied relation_types list.
For supporting_source_spans items, cite the exact quotes that cover the support.

response_contract.shape: Return ONLY one minified JSON object with exactly these keys: schema_version, case_id, condition, payload_sha256, instructions_sha256, fields.
header_rules: schema_version must be exactly 'phase2k-full-transcript-ablation-intermediate-response-v1'.
case_id and condition must copy the payload values exactly.
payload_sha256 and instructions_sha256 must copy the payload hashes exactly.
fields_rules: fields must contain exactly these keys: actors_entities, reference_bindings, abilities_resources, events_actions, states, conditions, recommended_advice, consequences_outcomes, explicit_relationships, uncertainty_unresolved, supporting_source_spans.
Each field value is a possibly-empty array of item objects.

Every item object has exactly the keys: extraction_text (non-empty string, max 2000 chars), resolution_status (one of literal_explicit, context_resolved, vocabulary_supported, unresolved), source_references (non-empty array).
Every source_reference object has exactly the keys: quote (non-empty exact substring of the condition source), occurrence_index (integer >= 0).

Items in the explicit_relationships field additionally have exactly one more key: relation_type (one of ACTOR, TARGET, USES, AFFECTS, CAUSES, ENABLES, PREVENTS, REQUIRES, CONDITION, RESULT, BEFORE, AFTER, UNTIL, NEGATES, REFERS_TO).

lexical_vocabulary.purpose: Bounded League of Legends lexical snapshot used only as Pass 1 mechanical-cleanup hints (ability keys, common summoner spells, basic domain tokens, and explicit champion alias spelling rules). It is intentionally not a semantic ontology and carries no ownership or champion-binding information; champion alias rules are lexical spelling data only and never produce entities, bindings, events, or relations.
lexical_vocabulary.scope_note: No ownership inference, no champion/role/motif classification, no champion binding, and no strategic abstraction. Champion alias hints are deterministic exact word-boundary spelling hints; guarded aliases require champion-shaped local syntax, metadata-licensed aliases require the supplied metadata value, and the never/uncertainty-only list must never be auto-repaired. Hints may only disambiguate local ASR surface forms in Pass 1 text restoration.

direct.note: Capital-initial Kale surfaces are unconditional Kayle hints; lowercase 'kale' (grocery/vegetable usage) is never eligible. The capitalization guard is documented and encoded in this rule.

metadata_licensed.note: Only eligible when the supplied champion metadata contains Darius; never inferred globally because Varus is a competing lexical possibility.

champion_abilities.name: Molten Shield
champion_abilities.description: Grants Annie or an ally a shield, a burst of Move Speed, and damages enemies who strike her with attacks or spells.

champion_abilities.name: Pyromania
champion_abilities.description:
After casting 4 spells, Annie's next offensive spell will stun the target.

Annie begins the game and respawns with Pyromania available.

champion_abilities.name: Disintegrate
champion_abilities.description: Annie hurls a Mana infused fireball, dealing damage and refunding the Mana cost if it destroys the target.

champion_abilities.name: Summon: Tibbers
champion_abilities.description: Annie wills her bear Tibbers to life, dealing damage to units in the area. Tibbers can attack and also burns enemies that stand near him.

champion_abilities.name: Incinerate
champion_abilities.description: Annie casts a blazing cone of fire, dealing damage to all enemies in the area.

champion_abilities.name: Playful / Trickster
champion_abilities.description: Fizz hops into the air, landing gracefully upon his spear and becoming untargetable. From this position, Fizz can either slam the ground or choose to jump again before smashing back down.

champion_abilities.name: Nimble Fighter
champion_abilities.description: Fizz can move through units and takes a flat amount of reduced damage from all sources

champion_abilities.name: Urchin Strike
champion_abilities.description: Fizz dashes through his target, dealing magic damage and applying on hit effects.

champion_abilities.name: Chum the Waters
champion_abilities.description: Fizz tosses a fish in a direction that attaches to any champion that touches it, slowing the target. After a short delay, a shark erupts from the ground, knocking up the target and knocking any nearby enemies aside. All enemies hit are dealt magic damage and slowed.

champion_abilities.name: Seastone Trident
champion_abilities.description: Fizz's attacks bleed his enemies, dealing magic damage over several seconds. Fizz can empower his next attack to deal bonus damage and empower his further attacks for a short time.

champion_abilities.name: Skip 'n Slash
champion_abilities.description: Gwen dashes a short distance then gains Attack Speed, attack range, and magic damage <OnHit>On-Hit</OnHit> for a few seconds. If she hits an enemy during that time, this Ability's cooldown is partially refunded.

champion_abilities.name: A Thousand Cuts
champion_abilities.description: Gwen's attacks deal bonus magic damage based on the targets health. She heals for a portion of the damage dealt to champions by this effect.

champion_abilities.name: Snip Snip!
champion_abilities.description: Gwen snips her scissors in a cone up to 6 times dealing magic damage. Gwen deals true damage to units in the center and applies her passive to them on each snip.

champion_abilities.name: Needlework
champion_abilities.description:
Gwen hurls a needle that slows enemies hit, deals magic damage, and applies A Thousand Cuts to champions hit.

This ability can be cast up to two more times, with each cast throwing additional needles and dealing more damage.

champion_abilities.name: Hallowed Mist
champion_abilities.description: Gwen summons mist that protects her from enemies outside of it. She can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist.

champion_abilities.name: Eye Of The Storm
champion_abilities.description: Janna conjures a defensive gale that shields an ally champion or turret from incoming damage and increases their Attack Damage.

champion_abilities.name: Tailwind
champion_abilities.description:
Janna's allies gain Move Speed moving towards her.

Janna deals a portion of bonus Move Speed as bonus magic damage on hit and with Zephyr.

champion_abilities.name: Howling Gale
champion_abilities.description: By creating a localized change in pressure and temperature, Janna is able to create a small storm that grows in size with time. She can activate the spell again to release the storm. On release this storm will fly towards the direction it was cast in, dealing damage and knocking away any enemies in its path.

champion_abilities.name: Monsoon
champion_abilities.description: Janna surrounds herself in a magical storm, throwing enemies back. After the storm has settled, soothing winds heal nearby allies while the ability is active.

champion_abilities.name: Zephyr
champion_abilities.description: Janna summons an air elemental that passively increases her Move Speed and enables her to pass through units. She may also activate this ability to deal damage and slow an enemy's Move Speed.

champion_abilities.name: Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate
champion_abilities.description:
Hammer Stance: Deals magic damage to an enemy and knocks them back a short distance.

Cannon Stance: Deploys an Acceleration Gate increasing the Move Speed of all allied champions who pass through it. If Shock Blast is fired through the gate the missile speed, range, and damage will increase.

champion_abilities.name: Hextech Capacitor
champion_abilities.description: When Jayce swaps weapons he gains Move Speed for a short duration.

champion_abilities.name: To the Skies! / Shock Blast
champion_abilities.description:
Hammer Stance: Leaps to an enemy dealing physical damage and slowing enemies.

Cannon Stance: Fires an orb of electricity that detonates upon hitting an enemy (or reaching the end of its path) dealing physical damage to all enemies hit.

champion_abilities.name: Mercury Cannon / Mercury Hammer
champion_abilities.description:
Hammer Stance: Transforms the Mercury Hammer into the Mercury Cannon gaining new abilities and increased range. The first attack in this form reduces the target's Armor and Magic Resist.

Cannon Stance: Transforms the Mercury Cannon into the Mercury Hammer gaining new abilities and increasing Armor and Magic Resist. The first attack in this form deals additional magic damage.

champion_abilities.name: Lightning Field / Hyper Charge
champion_abilities.description:
Hammer Stance: Passive: Restores Mana per strike. Active: Creates a field of lightning damaging nearby enemies for several seconds.

Cannon Stance: Gains a burst of energy, increasing Attack Speed to maximum for several attacks.

champion_abilities.name: Flame Chompers!
champion_abilities.description: Jinx throws out a line of snare grenades that explode after 5 seconds, lighting enemies on fire. Flame Chompers will bite enemy champions who walk over them, rooting them in place.

champion_abilities.name: Get Excited!
champion_abilities.description: Jinx receives massively increased Move Speed and Attack Speed whenever she helps kill or destroy an enemy champions epic jungle monster, or structure.

champion_abilities.name: Switcheroo!
champion_abilities.description: Jinx modifies her basic attacks by swapping between Pow-Pow, her minigun and Fishbones, her rocket launcher. Attacks with Pow-Pow grant Attack Speed, while attacks with Fishbones deal area of effect damage, gain increased range, but drain Mana and attack slower.

champion_abilities.name: Super Mega Death Rocket!
champion_abilities.description: Jinx fires a super rocket across the map that gains damage as it travels. The rocket will explode upon colliding with an enemy champion, dealing damage to it and surrounding enemies based on their missing Health.

champion_abilities.name: Zap!
champion_abilities.description: Jinx uses Zapper, her shock pistol, to fire a blast that deals damage to the first enemy hit, slowing and revealing it.

champion_abilities.name: Ethereal Chains
champion_abilities.description: LeBlanc launches a chain that shackles the first enemy hit. If the target remains shackled for 1.5 seconds, LeBlanc roots them and deals additional damage.

champion_abilities.name: Mirror Image
champion_abilities.description: When LeBlanc drops below 40% Health, she becomes invisible for 1 second and creates a Mirror Image that deals no damage and lasts for up to 8 seconds.

champion_abilities.name: Sigil of Malice
champion_abilities.description: LeBlanc projects a sigil, dealing damage and marking the target for 3.5 seconds. Damaging the marked target with an ability detonates the sigil, dealing additional damage. If either part kills the target, Leblanc refunds the Mana cost and part of this spell's remaining Cooldown.

champion_abilities.name: Mimic
champion_abilities.description: LeBlanc casts a mimicked version of one of her basic spells.

champion_abilities.name: Distortion
champion_abilities.description: LeBlanc dashes to a location, dealing damage to enemies near her destination. For the next 4 seconds, activate Distortion again to return LeBlanc to her starting location.

champion_abilities.name: Solar Snare
champion_abilities.description: Mel fires a radiant orb forward, rooting those at its center while the area around it slows enemies and deals damage over time.

champion_abilities.name: Searing Brilliance
champion_abilities.description:
Whenever Mel uses an ability, she gains three bonus projectiles (up to nine maximum) on her next attack.

When Mel deals damage through an ability or attack, she applies Overwhelm, which can stack infinitely. If the enemy is hit by Mel with enough Overwhelm damage, the stacks are consumed to execute the target.

champion_abilities.name: Radiant Volley
champion_abilities.description: Mel fires a barrage of projectiles that explode around a target location, dealing damage repeatedly to enemies within the area.

champion_abilities.name: Golden Eclipse
champion_abilities.description:
Mel strikes all enemies marked with Overwhelm regardless of their distance from her, dealing additional damage for each stack of Overwhelm.

Ranks of Golden Eclipse increase Overwhelm's damage.

champion_abilities.name: Rebuttal
champion_abilities.description: Mel forms a barrier around herself that reflects enemy projectiles back at the attacker, prevents her from taking damage, and grants her movement speed.

champion_abilities.name: Shadow Dash
champion_abilities.description: Shen dashes in a direction, taunting enemies in his path.

champion_abilities.name: Ki Barrier
champion_abilities.description: After casting a spell, Shen gets a shield. Affecting other champions reduces the cooldown of this effect.

champion_abilities.name: Twilight Assault
champion_abilities.description: Shen recalls his spirit blade to attack with it, dealing damage based on the target's max health. The attacks are greatly empowered if it collides with an enemy champion, and all collided enemies are slowed while running away from Shen.

champion_abilities.name: Stand United
champion_abilities.description: Shen shields target allied champion from incoming damage, and soon after teleports to their location.

champion_abilities.name: Spirit's Refuge
champion_abilities.description: Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked.

champion_abilities.name: Song of Celerity
champion_abilities.description: Sona plays the Song of Celerity, granting nearby allies bonus Move Speed. Sona gains a temporary aura that grants allied champions tagged by the zone bonus Move Speed.

champion_abilities.name: Power Chord
champion_abilities.description:
Accelerando: Sona gains non-Ultimate ability haste permanently for her basic abilities as she uses her abilities well, up to a cap. Beyond that cap, further successful uses reduce her ultimate's remaining cooldown instead.

Power Chord: Every few spell casts, Sona's next attack will deal bonus magic damage in addition to an additional effect based on what basic Ability Sona last activated.

champion_abilities.name: Hymn of Valor
champion_abilities.description: Sona plays the Hymn of Valor, sends out bolts of sound, dealing magic damage to two nearby enemies, prioritizing champions and monsters. Sona gains a temporary aura that grants allies tagged by the zone bonus damage on their next attack against enemies.

champion_abilities.name: Crescendo
champion_abilities.description: Sona plays her ultimate chord, stunning enemy champions and forcing them to dance and dealing magic damage to them.

champion_abilities.name: Aria of Perseverance
champion_abilities.description: Sona plays the Aria of Perseverance, sending out protective melodies, healing Sona and a nearby wounded ally. Sona gains a temporary aura that grants allies tagged by the zone a temporary shield.

champion_abilities.name: Molten Shield
champion_abilities.description: Grants Annie or an ally a shield, a burst of Move Speed, and damages enemies who strike her with attacks or spells.

champion_abilities.name: Pyromania
champion_abilities.description:
After casting 4 spells, Annie's next offensive spell will stun the target.

Annie begins the game and respawns with Pyromania available.

champion_abilities.name: Disintegrate
champion_abilities.description: Annie hurls a Mana infused fireball, dealing damage and refunding the Mana cost if it destroys the target.

champion_abilities.name: Summon: Tibbers
champion_abilities.description: Annie wills her bear Tibbers to life, dealing damage to units in the area. Tibbers can attack and also burns enemies that stand near him.

champion_abilities.name: Incinerate
champion_abilities.description: Annie casts a blazing cone of fire, dealing damage to all enemies in the area.

champion_abilities.name: Playful / Trickster
champion_abilities.description: Fizz hops into the air, landing gracefully upon his spear and becoming untargetable. From this position, Fizz can either slam the ground or choose to jump again before smashing back down.

champion_abilities.name: Nimble Fighter
champion_abilities.description: Fizz can move through units and takes a flat amount of reduced damage from all sources

champion_abilities.name: Urchin Strike
champion_abilities.description: Fizz dashes through his target, dealing magic damage and applying on hit effects.

champion_abilities.name: Chum the Waters
champion_abilities.description: Fizz tosses a fish in a direction that attaches to any champion that touches it, slowing the target. After a short delay, a shark erupts from the ground, knocking up the target and knocking any nearby enemies aside. All enemies hit are dealt magic damage and slowed.

champion_abilities.name: Seastone Trident
champion_abilities.description: Fizz's attacks bleed his enemies, dealing magic damage over several seconds. Fizz can empower his next attack to deal bonus damage and empower his further attacks for a short time.

champion_abilities.name: Skip 'n Slash
champion_abilities.description: Gwen dashes a short distance then gains Attack Speed, attack range, and magic damage <OnHit>On-Hit</OnHit> for a few seconds. If she hits an enemy during that time, this Ability's cooldown is partially refunded.

champion_abilities.name: A Thousand Cuts
champion_abilities.description: Gwen's attacks deal bonus magic damage based on the targets health. She heals for a portion of the damage dealt to champions by this effect.

champion_abilities.name: Snip Snip!
champion_abilities.description: Gwen snips her scissors in a cone up to 6 times dealing magic damage. Gwen deals true damage to units in the center and applies her passive to them on each snip.

champion_abilities.name: Needlework
champion_abilities.description:
Gwen hurls a needle that slows enemies hit, deals magic damage, and applies A Thousand Cuts to champions hit.

This ability can be cast up to two more times, with each cast throwing additional needles and dealing more damage.

champion_abilities.name: Hallowed Mist
champion_abilities.description: Gwen summons mist that protects her from enemies outside of it. She can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist.

champion_abilities.name: Eye Of The Storm
champion_abilities.description: Janna conjures a defensive gale that shields an ally champion or turret from incoming damage and increases their Attack Damage.

champion_abilities.name: Tailwind
champion_abilities.description:
Janna's allies gain Move Speed moving towards her.

Janna deals a portion of bonus Move Speed as bonus magic damage on hit and with Zephyr.

champion_abilities.name: Howling Gale
champion_abilities.description: By creating a localized change in pressure and temperature, Janna is able to create a small storm that grows in size with time. She can activate the spell again to release the storm. On release this storm will fly towards the direction it was cast in, dealing damage and knocking away any enemies in its path.

champion_abilities.name: Monsoon
champion_abilities.description: Janna surrounds herself in a magical storm, throwing enemies back. After the storm has settled, soothing winds heal nearby allies while the ability is active.

champion_abilities.name: Zephyr
champion_abilities.description: Janna summons an air elemental that passively increases her Move Speed and enables her to pass through units. She may also activate this ability to deal damage and slow an enemy's Move Speed.

champion_abilities.name: Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate
champion_abilities.description:
Hammer Stance: Deals magic damage to an enemy and knocks them back a short distance.

Cannon Stance: Deploys an Acceleration Gate increasing the Move Speed of all allied champions who pass through it. If Shock Blast is fired through the gate the missile speed, range, and damage will increase.

champion_abilities.name: Hextech Capacitor
champion_abilities.description: When Jayce swaps weapons he gains Move Speed for a short duration.

champion_abilities.name: To the Skies! / Shock Blast
champion_abilities.description:
Hammer Stance: Leaps to an enemy dealing physical damage and slowing enemies.

Cannon Stance: Fires an orb of electricity that detonates upon hitting an enemy (or reaching the end of its path) dealing physical damage to all enemies hit.

champion_abilities.name: Mercury Cannon / Mercury Hammer
champion_abilities.description:
Hammer Stance: Transforms the Mercury Hammer into the Mercury Cannon gaining new abilities and increased range. The first attack in this form reduces the target's Armor and Magic Resist.

Cannon Stance: Transforms the Mercury Cannon into the Mercury Hammer gaining new abilities and increasing Armor and Magic Resist. The first attack in this form deals additional magic damage.

champion_abilities.name: Lightning Field / Hyper Charge
champion_abilities.description:
Hammer Stance: Passive: Restores Mana per strike. Active: Creates a field of lightning damaging nearby enemies for several seconds.

Cannon Stance: Gains a burst of energy, increasing Attack Speed to maximum for several attacks.

champion_abilities.name: Flame Chompers!
champion_abilities.description: Jinx throws out a line of snare grenades that explode after 5 seconds, lighting enemies on fire. Flame Chompers will bite enemy champions who walk over them, rooting them in place.

champion_abilities.name: Get Excited!
champion_abilities.description: Jinx receives massively increased Move Speed and Attack Speed whenever she helps kill or destroy an enemy champions epic jungle monster, or structure.

champion_abilities.name: Switcheroo!
champion_abilities.description: Jinx modifies her basic attacks by swapping between Pow-Pow, her minigun and Fishbones, her rocket launcher. Attacks with Pow-Pow grant Attack Speed, while attacks with Fishbones deal area of effect damage, gain increased range, but drain Mana and attack slower.

champion_abilities.name: Super Mega Death Rocket!
champion_abilities.description: Jinx fires a super rocket across the map that gains damage as it travels. The rocket will explode upon colliding with an enemy champion, dealing damage to it and surrounding enemies based on their missing Health.

champion_abilities.name: Zap!
champion_abilities.description: Jinx uses Zapper, her shock pistol, to fire a blast that deals damage to the first enemy hit, slowing and revealing it.

champion_abilities.name: Ethereal Chains
champion_abilities.description: LeBlanc launches a chain that shackles the first enemy hit. If the target remains shackled for 1.5 seconds, LeBlanc roots them and deals additional damage.

champion_abilities.name: Mirror Image
champion_abilities.description: When LeBlanc drops below 40% Health, she becomes invisible for 1 second and creates a Mirror Image that deals no damage and lasts for up to 8 seconds.

champion_abilities.name: Sigil of Malice
champion_abilities.description: LeBlanc projects a sigil, dealing damage and marking the target for 3.5 seconds. Damaging the marked target with an ability detonates the sigil, dealing additional damage. If either part kills the target, Leblanc refunds the Mana cost and part of this spell's remaining Cooldown.

champion_abilities.name: Mimic
champion_abilities.description: LeBlanc casts a mimicked version of one of her basic spells.

champion_abilities.name: Distortion
champion_abilities.description: LeBlanc dashes to a location, dealing damage to enemies near her destination. For the next 4 seconds, activate Distortion again to return LeBlanc to her starting location.

champion_abilities.name: Solar Snare
champion_abilities.description: Mel fires a radiant orb forward, rooting those at its center while the area around it slows enemies and deals damage over time.

champion_abilities.name: Searing Brilliance
champion_abilities.description:
Whenever Mel uses an ability, she gains three bonus projectiles (up to nine maximum) on her next attack.

When Mel deals damage through an ability or attack, she applies Overwhelm, which can stack infinitely. If the enemy is hit by Mel with enough Overwhelm damage, the stacks are consumed to execute the target.

champion_abilities.name: Radiant Volley
champion_abilities.description: Mel fires a barrage of projectiles that explode around a target location, dealing damage repeatedly to enemies within the area.

champion_abilities.name: Golden Eclipse
champion_abilities.description:
Mel strikes all enemies marked with Overwhelm regardless of their distance from her, dealing additional damage for each stack of Overwhelm.

Ranks of Golden Eclipse increase Overwhelm's damage.

champion_abilities.name: Rebuttal
champion_abilities.description: Mel forms a barrier around herself that reflects enemy projectiles back at the attacker, prevents her from taking damage, and grants her movement speed.

champion_abilities.name: Shadow Dash
champion_abilities.description: Shen dashes in a direction, taunting enemies in his path.

champion_abilities.name: Ki Barrier
champion_abilities.description: After casting a spell, Shen gets a shield. Affecting other champions reduces the cooldown of this effect.

champion_abilities.name: Twilight Assault
champion_abilities.description: Shen recalls his spirit blade to attack with it, dealing damage based on the target's max health. The attacks are greatly empowered if it collides with an enemy champion, and all collided enemies are slowed while running away from Shen.

champion_abilities.name: Stand United
champion_abilities.description: Shen shields target allied champion from incoming damage, and soon after teleports to their location.

champion_abilities.name: Spirit's Refuge
champion_abilities.description: Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked.

champion_abilities.name: Song of Celerity
champion_abilities.description: Sona plays the Song of Celerity, granting nearby allies bonus Move Speed. Sona gains a temporary aura that grants allied champions tagged by the zone bonus Move Speed.

champion_abilities.name: Power Chord
champion_abilities.description:
Accelerando: Sona gains non-Ultimate ability haste permanently for her basic abilities as she uses her abilities well, up to a cap. Beyond that cap, further successful uses reduce her ultimate's remaining cooldown instead.

Power Chord: Every few spell casts, Sona's next attack will deal bonus magic damage in addition to an additional effect based on what basic Ability Sona last activated.

champion_abilities.name: Hymn of Valor
champion_abilities.description: Sona plays the Hymn of Valor, sends out bolts of sound, dealing magic damage to two nearby enemies, prioritizing champions and monsters. Sona gains a temporary aura that grants allies tagged by the zone bonus damage on their next attack against enemies.

champion_abilities.name: Crescendo
champion_abilities.description: Sona plays her ultimate chord, stunning enemy champions and forcing them to dance and dealing magic damage to them.

champion_abilities.name: Aria of Perseverance
champion_abilities.description: Sona plays the Aria of Perseverance, sending out protective melodies, healing Sona and a nearby wounded ally. Sona gains a temporary aura that grants allies tagged by the zone a temporary shield.
