lexical_vocabulary.purpose: Bounded League of Legends lexical snapshot used only as Pass 1 mechanical-cleanup hints (ability keys, common summoner spells, basic domain tokens, and explicit champion alias spelling rules). It is intentionally not a semantic ontology and carries no ownership or champion-binding information; champion alias rules are lexical spelling data only and never produce entities, bindings, events, or relations.
lexical_vocabulary.scope_note: No ownership inference, no champion/role/motif classification, no champion binding, and no strategic abstraction. Champion alias hints are deterministic exact word-boundary spelling hints; guarded aliases require champion-shaped local syntax, metadata-licensed aliases require the supplied metadata value, and the never/uncertainty-only list must never be auto-repaired. Hints may only disambiguate local ASR surface forms in Pass 1 text restoration.

direct.note: Capital-initial Kale surfaces are unconditional Kayle hints; lowercase 'kale' (grocery/vegetable usage) is never eligible. The capitalization guard is documented and encoded in this rule.

metadata_licensed.note: Only eligible when the supplied champion metadata contains Darius; never inferred globally because Varus is a competing lexical possibility.

never.note: Soie is never an automatic Zoe repair; it may only be recorded as a DOMAIN_TOKEN_UNCERTAIN uncertainty with Zoe among the alternatives.

champion_abilities.name: Trample
champion_abilities.description: Alistar tramples nearby enemy units, ignoring unit collision and gaining stacks if he damages an enemy champion. At full stacks Alistar's next basic attack against an enemy champion deals additional magic damage and stuns them.

champion_abilities.name: Triumphant Roar
champion_abilities.description: Alistar charges his roar by stunning or displacing enemy champions or when nearby enemies die. When fully charged he heals himself all nearby allied champions.

champion_abilities.name: Pulverize
champion_abilities.description: Alistar smashes the ground, dealing damage to nearby enemies and tossing them into the air.

champion_abilities.name: Unbreakable Will
champion_abilities.description: Alistar lets out a wild roar, removing all crowd control effects on himself, and reducing incoming physical and magical damage for the duration.

champion_abilities.name: Headbutt
champion_abilities.description: Alistar rams a target with his head, dealing damage and knocking the target back.

champion_abilities.name: Lunar Rush
champion_abilities.description:
Becomes the living embodiment of the vengeful moon, dashing to an enemy and dealing magic damage.

Lunar Rush has no cooldown when used to dash to an enemy afflicted with Moonlight. All other enemies will have the Moonlight debuff removed regardless of whether they were the target of Lunar Rush.

champion_abilities.name: Moonsilver Blade
champion_abilities.description: Every third strike cleaves nearby enemies for an additional magic damage. After casting a spell, Diana gains Attack Speed for 5 seconds.

champion_abilities.name: Crescent Strike
champion_abilities.description:
Unleashes a bolt of lunar energy in an arc dealing magic damage.

Afflicts enemies struck with Moonlight, revealing them if they are not stealthed for 3 seconds.

champion_abilities.name: Moonfall
champion_abilities.description:
Diana reveals and draws in all nearby enemies and slows them.

If Diana pulls in one or more enemy champions, the moonlight crashes down onto her after a short delay, dealing magic damage in an area around her, increased for each target beyond the first pulled.

champion_abilities.name: Pale Cascade
champion_abilities.description: Diana creates three orbiting spheres that detonate on contact with enemies to deal damage in an area. She also gains a temporary shield that absorbs damage. If her third sphere detonates, the shield gains additional strength.

champion_abilities.name: Zenith Blade
champion_abilities.description: Leona projects a solar image of her sword, dealing magic damage to all enemies in a line. When the image fades, the last enemy champion struck will be briefly immobilized and Leona will dash to them.

champion_abilities.name: Sunlight
champion_abilities.description: Damaging spells afflict enemies with Sunlight for 1.5 seconds. When allied Champions deal damage to those targets, they consume the Sunlight to deal additional magic damage.

champion_abilities.name: Shield of Daybreak
champion_abilities.description: Leona uses her shield to perform her next basic attack, dealing bonus magic damage and stunning the target.

champion_abilities.name: Solar Flare
champion_abilities.description: Leona calls down a beam of solar energy, dealing damage to enemies in an area. Enemies in the center of the area are stunned, while enemies on the outside are slowed.

champion_abilities.name: Eclipse
champion_abilities.description: Leona raises her shield to gain Damage Reduction, Armor, and Magic Resist. When the duration first ends, if there are nearby enemies, she will deal magic damage to them and prolong the duration of the effect.

champion_abilities.name: Relentless Pursuit
champion_abilities.description: Lucian quickly dashes a short distance. Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown.

champion_abilities.name: Lightslinger
champion_abilities.description: Whenever Lucian uses an ability, his next attack becomes a double-shot. When Lucian is healed or shielded by an ally, or when a nearby enemy Champion is immobilized, his next 2 basic attacks will deal bonus magic damage.

champion_abilities.name: Piercing Light
champion_abilities.description: Lucian shoots a bolt of piercing light through a target.

champion_abilities.name: The Culling
champion_abilities.description: Lucian unleashes a torrent of shots from his weapons.

champion_abilities.name: Ardent Blaze
champion_abilities.description: Lucian shoots a missile that explodes in a star shape, marking and briefly revealing enemies. Lucian gains Move Speed for attacking marked enemies.

champion_abilities.name: Warm Hugs
champion_abilities.description: Milio tosses a shield to an ally, temporarily increasing their movement speed. This ability has 2 charges.

champion_abilities.name: Fired Up!
champion_abilities.description: Milio's abilities enchant allies on touch, making their next damage deal a burst of extra damage and burn the target.

champion_abilities.name: Ultra Mega Fire Kick
champion_abilities.description: Kick a ball that knocks back an enemy. The ball launches upward on hit and falls toward the enemy, damaging and slowing enemies in the area upon impact.

champion_abilities.name: Breath of Life
champion_abilities.description: Milio unleashes a wave of soothing flames that heal and remove crowd control effects from allies in range.

champion_abilities.name: Cozy Campfire
champion_abilities.description: Create an empowering zone that heals allies and increases attack range to those inside. The zone follows the ally nearest to the cast point.

champion_abilities.name: Tidecaller's Blessing
champion_abilities.description: Empowers an allied champion for a short duration. The ally's basic attacks and spells deal bonus magic damage and slow the target.

champion_abilities.name: Surging Tides
champion_abilities.description: When Nami's Abilities hit allied champions they gain Move Speed for a short duration.

champion_abilities.name: Aqua Prison
champion_abilities.description: Sends a bubble to a target area, dealing damage and stunning all enemies on impact.

champion_abilities.name: Tidal Wave
champion_abilities.description: Summons a massive Tidal Wave that knocks up, slows, and damages enemies. Allies hit gain double the effect of Surging Tides.

champion_abilities.name: Ebb and Flow
champion_abilities.description: Unleashes a stream of water that bounces back and forth between allied and enemy champions, healing allies and damaging enemies.

champion_abilities.name: Curse of the Black Mist
champion_abilities.description: Senna draws the Mist she has stored in her weapon into a storm around her, embracing darkness and becoming a wraith within. Allies who enter the area are camouflaged and also appear as wraiths as the Mist shrouds them. Wraiths gain increased Move Speed, are unselectable, and hide their identities.

champion_abilities.name: Absolution
champion_abilities.description:
When units die near Senna, their souls are periodically trapped by the Black Mist. Senna can attack these souls to free them, absorbing the Mist that held them in death. Mist fuels her Relic Cannon's power with increased Attack Damage, Attack Range, and Critical Strike Chance.

Attacks from Senna's Relic Cannon take longer to fire, deal bonus damage, and briefly grant her a portion of her target's Move Speed.

champion_abilities.name: Piercing Darkness
champion_abilities.description: From the twin barrels of her Relic Cannon, Senna fires a unified beam of light and shadow through a target, healing allies and damaging enemies.

champion_abilities.name: Dawning Shadow
champion_abilities.description: Senna calls upon the relic stones of fallen Sentinels, splitting her relic cannon into a holy array of shadow and light. She then fires a global beam that shields allies from harm, while damaging enemies caught in the center.

champion_abilities.name: Last Embrace
champion_abilities.description: Senna sends forth a wave of Black Mist. If it hits an enemy it latches onto them hungrily, rooting them and everything nearby after a brief delay.

champion_abilities.name: Roar of the Slayer
champion_abilities.description: Sion fires a short range shockwave that damages and slows and reduces the Armor of the first enemy hit. If the shockwave hits a minion or monster, it will be knocked back, damaging, slowing, and reducing the Armor of all enemies that it passes through.

champion_abilities.name: Glory in Death
champion_abilities.description: After being killed, Sion will temporarily reanimate with rapidly decaying Health. His attacks become very rapid, heal him, and deal bonus damage based on his target's maximum Health.

champion_abilities.name: Decimating Smash
champion_abilities.description: Sion charges a powerful swing in an area in front of himself that will deal damage to enemies when released. If he charges for enough time, enemies hit by the swing will also be knocked up and stunned.

champion_abilities.name: Unstoppable Onslaught
champion_abilities.description: Sion charges in a direction, ramping up speed over time. He can steer his charge slightly with the mouse cursor location. When he collides with an enemy he deals damage and knocks them up based on the distance he has charged.

champion_abilities.name: Soul Furnace
champion_abilities.description: Sion shields himself and can reactivate after 3 seconds to deal Magic Damage to enemies nearby. When Sion kills enemies, he passively gains maximum Health.

champion_abilities.name: Scatter the Weak
champion_abilities.description: Syndra knocks enemies and Dark Spheres back dealing magic damage. Enemies hit by Dark Spheres become stunned.

champion_abilities.name: Transcendent
champion_abilities.description:
Syndra collects Splinters of Wrath from gaining levels and damaging enemies which upgrade her abilities.

Dark Sphere: Syndra can hold an additional charge
Force of Will: Bonus true damage.
Scatter the Weak: Increased width and slows all targets
Unleashed Power: Executes low health targets

champion_abilities.name: Dark Sphere
champion_abilities.description: Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere dealing magic damage. The sphere remains and can be manipulated by her other powers.

champion_abilities.name: Unleashed Power
champion_abilities.description: Syndra bombards an enemy Champion with all of her Dark Spheres.

champion_abilities.name: Force of Will
champion_abilities.description: Syndra picks up and throws a Dark Sphere or enemy minion dealing magic damage and slowing the Move Speed of enemies.

champion_abilities.name: Hail of Arrows
champion_abilities.description: Varus fires a hail of arrows that deal physical damage and desecrate the ground. Desecrated ground slows enemies' Move Speed and reduces their self healing and regeneration.

champion_abilities.name: Living Vengeance
champion_abilities.description: On kill or assist, Varus temporarily gains Attack Damage and Ability Power. This bonus is larger if the enemy is a champion.

champion_abilities.name: Piercing Arrow
champion_abilities.description: Varus readies and then fires a powerful shot that gains extra range and damage the longer he spends preparing to fire.

champion_abilities.name: Chain of Corruption
champion_abilities.description: Varus flings out a damaging tendril of corruption that immobilizes the first enemy champion hit and then spreads towards nearby uninfected champions, immobilizing them too on contact.

champion_abilities.name: Blighted Quiver
champion_abilities.description: Passive: Varus' basic attacks deal bonus magic damage and apply Blight. Varus' other abilities detonate Blight, dealing magic damage based on the target's maximum Health. Active: Varus empowers his next Piercing Arrow.

champion_abilities.name: Trample
champion_abilities.description: Alistar tramples nearby enemy units, ignoring unit collision and gaining stacks if he damages an enemy champion. At full stacks Alistar's next basic attack against an enemy champion deals additional magic damage and stuns them.

champion_abilities.name: Triumphant Roar
champion_abilities.description: Alistar charges his roar by stunning or displacing enemy champions or when nearby enemies die. When fully charged he heals himself all nearby allied champions.

champion_abilities.name: Pulverize
champion_abilities.description: Alistar smashes the ground, dealing damage to nearby enemies and tossing them into the air.

champion_abilities.name: Unbreakable Will
champion_abilities.description: Alistar lets out a wild roar, removing all crowd control effects on himself, and reducing incoming physical and magical damage for the duration.

champion_abilities.name: Headbutt
champion_abilities.description: Alistar rams a target with his head, dealing damage and knocking the target back.

champion_abilities.name: Lunar Rush
champion_abilities.description:
Becomes the living embodiment of the vengeful moon, dashing to an enemy and dealing magic damage.

Lunar Rush has no cooldown when used to dash to an enemy afflicted with Moonlight. All other enemies will have the Moonlight debuff removed regardless of whether they were the target of Lunar Rush.

champion_abilities.name: Moonsilver Blade
champion_abilities.description: Every third strike cleaves nearby enemies for an additional magic damage. After casting a spell, Diana gains Attack Speed for 5 seconds.

champion_abilities.name: Crescent Strike
champion_abilities.description:
Unleashes a bolt of lunar energy in an arc dealing magic damage.

Afflicts enemies struck with Moonlight, revealing them if they are not stealthed for 3 seconds.

champion_abilities.name: Moonfall
champion_abilities.description:
Diana reveals and draws in all nearby enemies and slows them.

If Diana pulls in one or more enemy champions, the moonlight crashes down onto her after a short delay, dealing magic damage in an area around her, increased for each target beyond the first pulled.

champion_abilities.name: Pale Cascade
champion_abilities.description: Diana creates three orbiting spheres that detonate on contact with enemies to deal damage in an area. She also gains a temporary shield that absorbs damage. If her third sphere detonates, the shield gains additional strength.

champion_abilities.name: Zenith Blade
champion_abilities.description: Leona projects a solar image of her sword, dealing magic damage to all enemies in a line. When the image fades, the last enemy champion struck will be briefly immobilized and Leona will dash to them.

champion_abilities.name: Sunlight
champion_abilities.description: Damaging spells afflict enemies with Sunlight for 1.5 seconds. When allied Champions deal damage to those targets, they consume the Sunlight to deal additional magic damage.

champion_abilities.name: Shield of Daybreak
champion_abilities.description: Leona uses her shield to perform her next basic attack, dealing bonus magic damage and stunning the target.

champion_abilities.name: Solar Flare
champion_abilities.description: Leona calls down a beam of solar energy, dealing damage to enemies in an area. Enemies in the center of the area are stunned, while enemies on the outside are slowed.

champion_abilities.name: Eclipse
champion_abilities.description: Leona raises her shield to gain Damage Reduction, Armor, and Magic Resist. When the duration first ends, if there are nearby enemies, she will deal magic damage to them and prolong the duration of the effect.

champion_abilities.name: Relentless Pursuit
champion_abilities.description: Lucian quickly dashes a short distance. Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown.

champion_abilities.name: Lightslinger
champion_abilities.description: Whenever Lucian uses an ability, his next attack becomes a double-shot. When Lucian is healed or shielded by an ally, or when a nearby enemy Champion is immobilized, his next 2 basic attacks will deal bonus magic damage.

champion_abilities.name: Piercing Light
champion_abilities.description: Lucian shoots a bolt of piercing light through a target.

champion_abilities.name: The Culling
champion_abilities.description: Lucian unleashes a torrent of shots from his weapons.

champion_abilities.name: Ardent Blaze
champion_abilities.description: Lucian shoots a missile that explodes in a star shape, marking and briefly revealing enemies. Lucian gains Move Speed for attacking marked enemies.

champion_abilities.name: Warm Hugs
champion_abilities.description: Milio tosses a shield to an ally, temporarily increasing their movement speed. This ability has 2 charges.

champion_abilities.name: Fired Up!
champion_abilities.description: Milio's abilities enchant allies on touch, making their next damage deal a burst of extra damage and burn the target.

champion_abilities.name: Ultra Mega Fire Kick
champion_abilities.description: Kick a ball that knocks back an enemy. The ball launches upward on hit and falls toward the enemy, damaging and slowing enemies in the area upon impact.

champion_abilities.name: Breath of Life
champion_abilities.description: Milio unleashes a wave of soothing flames that heal and remove crowd control effects from allies in range.

champion_abilities.name: Cozy Campfire
champion_abilities.description: Create an empowering zone that heals allies and increases attack range to those inside. The zone follows the ally nearest to the cast point.

champion_abilities.name: Tidecaller's Blessing
champion_abilities.description: Empowers an allied champion for a short duration. The ally's basic attacks and spells deal bonus magic damage and slow the target.

champion_abilities.name: Surging Tides
champion_abilities.description: When Nami's Abilities hit allied champions they gain Move Speed for a short duration.

champion_abilities.name: Aqua Prison
champion_abilities.description: Sends a bubble to a target area, dealing damage and stunning all enemies on impact.

champion_abilities.name: Tidal Wave
champion_abilities.description: Summons a massive Tidal Wave that knocks up, slows, and damages enemies. Allies hit gain double the effect of Surging Tides.

champion_abilities.name: Ebb and Flow
champion_abilities.description: Unleashes a stream of water that bounces back and forth between allied and enemy champions, healing allies and damaging enemies.

champion_abilities.name: Curse of the Black Mist
champion_abilities.description: Senna draws the Mist she has stored in her weapon into a storm around her, embracing darkness and becoming a wraith within. Allies who enter the area are camouflaged and also appear as wraiths as the Mist shrouds them. Wraiths gain increased Move Speed, are unselectable, and hide their identities.

champion_abilities.name: Absolution
champion_abilities.description:
When units die near Senna, their souls are periodically trapped by the Black Mist. Senna can attack these souls to free them, absorbing the Mist that held them in death. Mist fuels her Relic Cannon's power with increased Attack Damage, Attack Range, and Critical Strike Chance.

Attacks from Senna's Relic Cannon take longer to fire, deal bonus damage, and briefly grant her a portion of her target's Move Speed.

champion_abilities.name: Piercing Darkness
champion_abilities.description: From the twin barrels of her Relic Cannon, Senna fires a unified beam of light and shadow through a target, healing allies and damaging enemies.

champion_abilities.name: Dawning Shadow
champion_abilities.description: Senna calls upon the relic stones of fallen Sentinels, splitting her relic cannon into a holy array of shadow and light. She then fires a global beam that shields allies from harm, while damaging enemies caught in the center.

champion_abilities.name: Last Embrace
champion_abilities.description: Senna sends forth a wave of Black Mist. If it hits an enemy it latches onto them hungrily, rooting them and everything nearby after a brief delay.

champion_abilities.name: Roar of the Slayer
champion_abilities.description: Sion fires a short range shockwave that damages and slows and reduces the Armor of the first enemy hit. If the shockwave hits a minion or monster, it will be knocked back, damaging, slowing, and reducing the Armor of all enemies that it passes through.

champion_abilities.name: Glory in Death
champion_abilities.description: After being killed, Sion will temporarily reanimate with rapidly decaying Health. His attacks become very rapid, heal him, and deal bonus damage based on his target's maximum Health.

champion_abilities.name: Decimating Smash
champion_abilities.description: Sion charges a powerful swing in an area in front of himself that will deal damage to enemies when released. If he charges for enough time, enemies hit by the swing will also be knocked up and stunned.

champion_abilities.name: Unstoppable Onslaught
champion_abilities.description: Sion charges in a direction, ramping up speed over time. He can steer his charge slightly with the mouse cursor location. When he collides with an enemy he deals damage and knocks them up based on the distance he has charged.

champion_abilities.name: Soul Furnace
champion_abilities.description: Sion shields himself and can reactivate after 3 seconds to deal Magic Damage to enemies nearby. When Sion kills enemies, he passively gains maximum Health.

champion_abilities.name: Scatter the Weak
champion_abilities.description: Syndra knocks enemies and Dark Spheres back dealing magic damage. Enemies hit by Dark Spheres become stunned.

champion_abilities.name: Transcendent
champion_abilities.description:
Syndra collects Splinters of Wrath from gaining levels and damaging enemies which upgrade her abilities.

Dark Sphere: Syndra can hold an additional charge
Force of Will: Bonus true damage.
Scatter the Weak: Increased width and slows all targets
Unleashed Power: Executes low health targets

champion_abilities.name: Dark Sphere
champion_abilities.description: Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere dealing magic damage. The sphere remains and can be manipulated by her other powers.

champion_abilities.name: Unleashed Power
champion_abilities.description: Syndra bombards an enemy Champion with all of her Dark Spheres.

champion_abilities.name: Force of Will
champion_abilities.description: Syndra picks up and throws a Dark Sphere or enemy minion dealing magic damage and slowing the Move Speed of enemies.

champion_abilities.name: Hail of Arrows
champion_abilities.description: Varus fires a hail of arrows that deal physical damage and desecrate the ground. Desecrated ground slows enemies' Move Speed and reduces their self healing and regeneration.

champion_abilities.name: Living Vengeance
champion_abilities.description: On kill or assist, Varus temporarily gains Attack Damage and Ability Power. This bonus is larger if the enemy is a champion.

champion_abilities.name: Piercing Arrow
champion_abilities.description: Varus readies and then fires a powerful shot that gains extra range and damage the longer he spends preparing to fire.

champion_abilities.name: Chain of Corruption
champion_abilities.description: Varus flings out a damaging tendril of corruption that immobilizes the first enemy champion hit and then spreads towards nearby uninfected champions, immobilizing them too on contact.

champion_abilities.name: Blighted Quiver
champion_abilities.description: Passive: Varus' basic attacks deal bonus magic damage and apply Blight. Varus' other abilities detonate Blight, dealing magic damage based on the target's maximum Health. Active: Varus empowers his next Piercing Arrow.

lexical_vocabulary.purpose: Bounded League of Legends lexical snapshot used only as Pass 1 mechanical-cleanup hints (ability keys, common summoner spells, basic domain tokens, and explicit champion alias spelling rules). It is intentionally not a semantic ontology and carries no ownership or champion-binding information; champion alias rules are lexical spelling data only and never produce entities, bindings, events, or relations.
lexical_vocabulary.scope_note: No ownership inference, no champion/role/motif classification, no champion binding, and no strategic abstraction. Champion alias hints are deterministic exact word-boundary spelling hints; guarded aliases require champion-shaped local syntax, metadata-licensed aliases require the supplied metadata value, and the never/uncertainty-only list must never be auto-repaired. Hints may only disambiguate local ASR surface forms in Pass 1 text restoration.

direct.note: Capital-initial Kale surfaces are unconditional Kayle hints; lowercase 'kale' (grocery/vegetable usage) is never eligible. The capitalization guard is documented and encoded in this rule.

metadata_licensed.note: Only eligible when the supplied champion metadata contains Darius; never inferred globally because Varus is a competing lexical possibility.

never.note: Soie is never an automatic Zoe repair; it may only be recorded as a DOMAIN_TOKEN_UNCERTAIN uncertainty with Zoe among the alternatives.

champion_abilities.name: Lacerate
champion_abilities.description: Ambessa whips her twin drakehounds around herself, damaging and slowing nearby enemies. Initiating Drakehound's Step from this ability causes her to strike a second time at the end of its dash.

champion_abilities.name: Drakehound's Step
champion_abilities.description: Entering an attack or movement command while casting an ability will cause Ambessa to dash a short distance once the ability is cast, granting her next attack bonus range, damage, and attack speed, and refunding energy.

champion_abilities.name: Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam
champion_abilities.description: Ambessa sweeps her twin drakehounds in a semicircle in front of her, dealing bonus damage to enemies hit by the blades. Striking an enemy will transform the next cast of this ability for a short period of time, causing her to slam her twin drakehounds down in a line in front of her, dealing bonus damage to the first enemy hit.

champion_abilities.name: Public Execution
champion_abilities.description: Ambessa blinks to the farthest enemy champion in a line of her choosing and suppresses them upon her arrival. She then slams the enemy into the ground where they take damage and are stunned.

champion_abilities.name: Repudiation
champion_abilities.description: Ambessa gains a shield, briefly braces herself, and then slams the ground to damage nearby enemies. If she blocked any non-minion damage while bracing herself, this ability will deal increased damage.

champion_abilities.name: Magical Journey
champion_abilities.description: Bard opens a portal in nearby terrain. Allies and enemies alike can take a one-way trip through that terrain by moving into the portal.

champion_abilities.name: Traveler's Call
champion_abilities.description:
Meeps: Bard attracts lesser spirits that assist with his basic attacks to deal extra magic damage. When Bard has collected enough Chimes, his meeps will also deal damage in an area and slow enemies hit.

Chimes: Ancient chimes randomly appear for Bard to collect. These grant experience, restore mana, and provide out of combat Move Speed.

champion_abilities.name: Cosmic Binding
champion_abilities.description: Bard fires a missile which will slow the first enemy struck, and continue onward. If it strikes a wall, it will stun the initial target; if it strikes another enemy, it will stun them both.

champion_abilities.name: Tempered Fate
champion_abilities.description: Bard sends spirit energy arcing to a location, putting all champions, minions, monsters, and turrets hit into stasis for a brief time.

champion_abilities.name: Caretaker's Shrine
champion_abilities.description: Reveals a Health shrine which powers up over a short time, disappearing after healing and speeding up the first ally that touches it.

champion_abilities.name: Hookshot
champion_abilities.description: Camille pulls herself to a wall, leaping off and knocking up enemy champions upon landing.

champion_abilities.name: Adaptive Defenses
champion_abilities.description: Basic attacks on champions grant a shield equal to a percentage of Camille's maximum health against their damage type (Physical or Magic) for a brief duration.

champion_abilities.name: Precision Protocol
champion_abilities.description: Camille's next attack deals bonus damage and grants bonus Move Speed. This spell can be recast for a short period of time, doing significantly increased bonus damage if Camille delays a period of time between the two attacks.

champion_abilities.name: The Hextech Ultimatum
champion_abilities.description: Camille dashes to target champion, anchoring them to the area. She also deals bonus magic damage to the target with her basic attacks.

champion_abilities.name: Tactical Sweep
champion_abilities.description: Camille blasts in a cone after a delay, dealing damage. Enemies in the outer half are slowed and take extra damage, while also healing Camille.

champion_abilities.name: Arcane Shift
champion_abilities.description: Ezreal teleports to a target nearby location and fires a homing bolt which strikes the nearest enemy unit. Prioritizes enemies stuck with Essence Flux.

champion_abilities.name: Rising Spell Force
champion_abilities.description: Ezreal gains increasing Attack Speed each time he successfully hits a spell, stacking up to 5 times.

champion_abilities.name: Mystic Shot
champion_abilities.description: Ezreal fires a damaging bolt of energy which reduces all of his cooldowns slightly if it strikes an enemy unit.

champion_abilities.name: Trueshot Barrage
champion_abilities.description: Ezreal winds up before firing a powerful barrage of energy that deals massive damage to each unit it passes through (damage is reduced for minions and non-epic monsters).

champion_abilities.name: Essence Flux
champion_abilities.description: Ezreal fires an orb that sticks to the first champion or objective hit. If Ezreal hits an enemy with the orb, it detonates and deals damage.

champion_abilities.name: Bladework
champion_abilities.description: Fiora has increased attack speed for the next two attacks. The first attack slows the target, and the second attack will critically strike.

champion_abilities.name: Duelist's Dance
champion_abilities.description: Fiora has revealed a <keywordMajor>Vital</keywordMajor> on this Champion. If she hits the <keywordMajor>Vital</keywordMajor>, she <healing>restores Health</healing> and gains <speed>Move Speed</speed>.

champion_abilities.name: Lunge
champion_abilities.description: Fiora lunges in a direction and stabs a nearby enemy, dealing physical damage and applying on-hit effects.

champion_abilities.name: Grand Challenge
champion_abilities.description: Fiora reveals all four Vitals on an enemy champion and gains Move Speed while near them. If Fiora hits all four Vitals or if the target dies after she has hit at least one, Fiora and her allies in the area are healed over the next few seconds.

champion_abilities.name: Riposte
champion_abilities.description: Fiora parries all incoming damage and disables for a short time, then stabs in a direction. This stab slows the first enemy champion hit, or stuns them if Fiora blocked an immobilizing effect with this ability.

champion_abilities.name: Skip 'n Slash
champion_abilities.description: Gwen dashes a short distance then gains Attack Speed, attack range, and magic damage <OnHit>On-Hit</OnHit> for a few seconds. If she hits an enemy during that time, this Ability's cooldown is partially refunded.

champion_abilities.name: A Thousand Cuts
champion_abilities.description: Gwen's attacks deal bonus magic damage based on the targets health. She heals for a portion of the damage dealt to champions by this effect.

champion_abilities.name: Snip Snip!
champion_abilities.description: Gwen snips her scissors in a cone up to 6 times dealing magic damage. Gwen deals true damage to units in the center and applies her passive to them on each snip.

champion_abilities.name: Needlework
champion_abilities.description:
Gwen hurls a needle that slows enemies hit, deals magic damage, and applies A Thousand Cuts to champions hit.

This ability can be cast up to two more times, with each cast throwing additional needles and dealing more damage.

champion_abilities.name: Hallowed Mist
champion_abilities.description: Gwen summons mist that protects her from enemies outside of it. She can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist.

champion_abilities.name: Counter Strike
champion_abilities.description: Jax's combat prowess allows him to dodge all incoming attacks for a short duration and then quickly counterattack, stunning all surrounding enemies.

champion_abilities.name: Relentless Assault
champion_abilities.description: Jax's consecutive basic attacks continuously increase his Attack Speed.

champion_abilities.name: Leap Strike
champion_abilities.description: Jax leaps toward a unit. If they are an enemy, he strikes them with his weapon.

champion_abilities.name: Grandmaster-at-Arms
champion_abilities.description: Every third consecutive attack deals additional Magic Damage. Additionally, Jax can activate this ability to deal damage around himself and strengthen his resolve, increasing his Armor and Magic Resist for a short duration.

champion_abilities.name: Empower
champion_abilities.description: Jax charges his weapon with energy, causing his next attack to deal additional damage.

champion_abilities.name: Tempest / Cripple
champion_abilities.description:
Tempest: Lee Sin smashes the ground, sending out a shockwave that deals magic damage and reveals enemy units hit. If Tempest hits an enemy, Lee Sin can cast cripple.
Cripple: Lee Sin cripples nearby enemies damaged by Tempest, reducing their Move Speed. Move Speed recovers gradually over the duration.

champion_abilities.name: Flurry
champion_abilities.description: After Lee Sin uses an ability, his next 2 basic attacks gain Attack Speed and return Energy.

champion_abilities.name: Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike
champion_abilities.description:
Sonic Wave: Lee Sin projects a discordant wave of sound to locate his enemies, dealing physical damage to the first enemy it encounters. If Sonic Wave hits, Lee Sin can cast Resonating Strike for the next 3 seconds.
Resonating Strike: Lee Sin dashes to the enemy hit by Sonic Wave, dealing physical damage based on the target's missing Health.

champion_abilities.name: Dragon's Rage
champion_abilities.description: Lee Sin performs a powerful roundhouse kick launching his target back, dealing physical damage to the target and any enemies they collide with. Enemies the target collides with are knocked into the air for a short duration. This technique was taught to him by Jesse Perring, although Lee Sin does not kick players off the map.

champion_abilities.name: Safeguard / Iron Will
champion_abilities.description:
Safeguard: Lee Sin rushes to target ally, shielding himself from damage. If the ally is a champion, they are also shielded. After using Safeguard, Lee Sin can cast Iron Will.
Iron Will: Lee Sin's intense training allows him to thrive in battle. Lee Sin gains Omnivamp.

champion_abilities.name: Lucent Singularity
champion_abilities.description: Fires an anomaly of twisted light to an area, which slows nearby enemies. Lux can detonate it to damage enemies in the area of effect.

champion_abilities.name: Illumination
champion_abilities.description: Lux's damaging spells charge the target with energy for a few seconds. Lux's next attack ignites the energy, dealing bonus magic damage (depending on Lux's level) to the target.

champion_abilities.name: Light Binding
champion_abilities.description: Lux releases a sphere of light that binds and deals damage to up to two enemy units.

champion_abilities.name: Final Spark
champion_abilities.description: After gathering energy, Lux fires a beam of light that deals damage to all targets in the area. In addition, triggers Lux's passive ability and refreshes the Illumination debuff duration.

champion_abilities.name: Prismatic Barrier
champion_abilities.description: Lux throws her wand and bends the light around any friendly target it touches, protecting them from enemy damage.

champion_abilities.name: Heroic Charge
champion_abilities.description: Poppy dashes to the target and pushes it back. If the target is pushed into a wall, it is stunned.

champion_abilities.name: Iron Ambassador
champion_abilities.description: Poppy throws her buckler that bounces off the target. Poppy can pick it up to gain a temporary shield.

champion_abilities.name: Hammer Shock
champion_abilities.description: Poppy swings her hammer, dealing damage and creating a zone that will slow enemies and explode after a delay.

champion_abilities.name: Keeper's Verdict
champion_abilities.description: Poppy channels a hammer strike that knocks enemies very far away.

champion_abilities.name: Steadfast Presence
champion_abilities.description: Poppy passively gains Armor and Magic Resist. This bonus increases when she is low on Health. Poppy can activate Steadfast Presence to gain Move Speed and stop enemy dashes around her. If a dash is stopped, the enemy is slowed and grounded.

champion_abilities.name: Slice and Dice
champion_abilities.description: Renekton dashes, dealing damage to units along the way. Empowered, Renekton deals bonus damage and reduces the Armor of units hit.

champion_abilities.name: Reign of Anger
champion_abilities.description: Renekton's attacks generate Fury, increased when he is low on life. This Fury can empower his abilities with bonus effects.

champion_abilities.name: Cull the Meek
champion_abilities.description: Renekton swings his blade, dealing moderate physical damage to all targets around him, and heals for a small portion of the damage dealt. If he has more than 50 Fury, his damage and heal are increased.

champion_abilities.name: Dominus
champion_abilities.description: Renekton transforms into the Tyrant form, gaining bonus Health and dealing damage to enemies around him. While in this form, Renekton gains Fury periodically.

champion_abilities.name: Ruthless Predator
champion_abilities.description: Renekton slashes his target twice, dealing moderate physical damage and stuns them for 0.75 seconds. If Renekton has more than 50 Fury, he slashes his target three times, destroying damage shields on the target, dealing high physical damage, and stunning them for 1.5 seconds.

champion_abilities.name: Bola Strike
champion_abilities.description:
Rengar throws a bola, slowing the first target hit for a short duration.

Ferocity effect: roots the target.

champion_abilities.name: Unseen Predator
champion_abilities.description:
While in Brush, Rengar leaps at his target with his basic attack.

Rengar generates Ferocity whenever he casts an ability. At Max Ferocity, his next ability is empowered.

Killing enemy champions awards trophies on Rengar's Bonetooth Necklace, granting bonus attack damage.

champion_abilities.name: Savagery
champion_abilities.description:
Rengar's next Attack brutally stabs his target for bonus damage.

Ferocity effect: deals increased damage and grants Attack Speed.

champion_abilities.name: Thrill of the Hunt
champion_abilities.description: Rengar's predatory instincts take over, <font color='#cd90ee'>Camouflaging</font> him and revealing the nearest enemy champion in a large radius around him. During Thrill of the Hunt, Rengar gains Move Speed and he can leap to the tracked enemy without being in brush, reducing their armor.

champion_abilities.name: Battle Roar
champion_abilities.description:
Rengar lets out a battle roar, damaging enemies and healing for some of the recent damage he has taken.

Ferocity effect: additionally breaks crowd control effects.

champion_abilities.name: Valor
champion_abilities.description: Riven steps forward a short distance and blocks incoming damage.

champion_abilities.name: Runic Blade
champion_abilities.description: Riven's abilities charge her blade, and her basic attacks expend charges to deal an additional damage.

champion_abilities.name: Broken Wings
champion_abilities.description: Riven lashes out in a series of strikes. This ability can be reactivated three times in a short time frame with the third hit knocking back nearby enemies.

champion_abilities.name: Blade of the Exile
champion_abilities.description: Riven empowers her keepsake weapon with energy, and gains Attack Damage and Range. During this time, she also gains the ability to use Wind Slash, a powerful ranged attack, once.

champion_abilities.name: Ki Burst
champion_abilities.description: Riven emits a Ki Burst, damaging and stunning nearby enemies.

champion_abilities.name: Shadow Dash
champion_abilities.description: Shen dashes in a direction, taunting enemies in his path.

champion_abilities.name: Ki Barrier
champion_abilities.description: After casting a spell, Shen gets a shield. Affecting other champions reduces the cooldown of this effect.

champion_abilities.name: Twilight Assault
champion_abilities.description: Shen recalls his spirit blade to attack with it, dealing damage based on the target's max health. The attacks are greatly empowered if it collides with an enemy champion, and all collided enemies are slowed while running away from Shen.

champion_abilities.name: Stand United
champion_abilities.description: Shen shields target allied champion from incoming damage, and soon after teleports to their location.

champion_abilities.name: Spirit's Refuge
champion_abilities.description: Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked.

champion_abilities.name: Lacerate
champion_abilities.description: Ambessa whips her twin drakehounds around herself, damaging and slowing nearby enemies. Initiating Drakehound's Step from this ability causes her to strike a second time at the end of its dash.

champion_abilities.name: Drakehound's Step
champion_abilities.description: Entering an attack or movement command while casting an ability will cause Ambessa to dash a short distance once the ability is cast, granting her next attack bonus range, damage, and attack speed, and refunding energy.

champion_abilities.name: Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam
champion_abilities.description: Ambessa sweeps her twin drakehounds in a semicircle in front of her, dealing bonus damage to enemies hit by the blades. Striking an enemy will transform the next cast of this ability for a short period of time, causing her to slam her twin drakehounds down in a line in front of her, dealing bonus damage to the first enemy hit.

champion_abilities.name: Public Execution
champion_abilities.description: Ambessa blinks to the farthest enemy champion in a line of her choosing and suppresses them upon her arrival. She then slams the enemy into the ground where they take damage and are stunned.

champion_abilities.name: Repudiation
champion_abilities.description: Ambessa gains a shield, briefly braces herself, and then slams the ground to damage nearby enemies. If she blocked any non-minion damage while bracing herself, this ability will deal increased damage.

champion_abilities.name: Magical Journey
champion_abilities.description: Bard opens a portal in nearby terrain. Allies and enemies alike can take a one-way trip through that terrain by moving into the portal.

champion_abilities.name: Traveler's Call
champion_abilities.description:
Meeps: Bard attracts lesser spirits that assist with his basic attacks to deal extra magic damage. When Bard has collected enough Chimes, his meeps will also deal damage in an area and slow enemies hit.

Chimes: Ancient chimes randomly appear for Bard to collect. These grant experience, restore mana, and provide out of combat Move Speed.

champion_abilities.name: Cosmic Binding
champion_abilities.description: Bard fires a missile which will slow the first enemy struck, and continue onward. If it strikes a wall, it will stun the initial target; if it strikes another enemy, it will stun them both.

champion_abilities.name: Tempered Fate
champion_abilities.description: Bard sends spirit energy arcing to a location, putting all champions, minions, monsters, and turrets hit into stasis for a brief time.

champion_abilities.name: Caretaker's Shrine
champion_abilities.description: Reveals a Health shrine which powers up over a short time, disappearing after healing and speeding up the first ally that touches it.

champion_abilities.name: Hookshot
champion_abilities.description: Camille pulls herself to a wall, leaping off and knocking up enemy champions upon landing.

champion_abilities.name: Adaptive Defenses
champion_abilities.description: Basic attacks on champions grant a shield equal to a percentage of Camille's maximum health against their damage type (Physical or Magic) for a brief duration.

champion_abilities.name: Precision Protocol
champion_abilities.description: Camille's next attack deals bonus damage and grants bonus Move Speed. This spell can be recast for a short period of time, doing significantly increased bonus damage if Camille delays a period of time between the two attacks.

champion_abilities.name: The Hextech Ultimatum
champion_abilities.description: Camille dashes to target champion, anchoring them to the area. She also deals bonus magic damage to the target with her basic attacks.

champion_abilities.name: Tactical Sweep
champion_abilities.description: Camille blasts in a cone after a delay, dealing damage. Enemies in the outer half are slowed and take extra damage, while also healing Camille.

champion_abilities.name: Arcane Shift
champion_abilities.description: Ezreal teleports to a target nearby location and fires a homing bolt which strikes the nearest enemy unit. Prioritizes enemies stuck with Essence Flux.

champion_abilities.name: Rising Spell Force
champion_abilities.description: Ezreal gains increasing Attack Speed each time he successfully hits a spell, stacking up to 5 times.

champion_abilities.name: Mystic Shot
champion_abilities.description: Ezreal fires a damaging bolt of energy which reduces all of his cooldowns slightly if it strikes an enemy unit.

champion_abilities.name: Trueshot Barrage
champion_abilities.description: Ezreal winds up before firing a powerful barrage of energy that deals massive damage to each unit it passes through (damage is reduced for minions and non-epic monsters).

champion_abilities.name: Essence Flux
champion_abilities.description: Ezreal fires an orb that sticks to the first champion or objective hit. If Ezreal hits an enemy with the orb, it detonates and deals damage.

champion_abilities.name: Bladework
champion_abilities.description: Fiora has increased attack speed for the next two attacks. The first attack slows the target, and the second attack will critically strike.

champion_abilities.name: Duelist's Dance
champion_abilities.description: Fiora has revealed a <keywordMajor>Vital</keywordMajor> on this Champion. If she hits the <keywordMajor>Vital</keywordMajor>, she <healing>restores Health</healing> and gains <speed>Move Speed</speed>.

champion_abilities.name: Lunge
champion_abilities.description: Fiora lunges in a direction and stabs a nearby enemy, dealing physical damage and applying on-hit effects.

champion_abilities.name: Grand Challenge
champion_abilities.description: Fiora reveals all four Vitals on an enemy champion and gains Move Speed while near them. If Fiora hits all four Vitals or if the target dies after she has hit at least one, Fiora and her allies in the area are healed over the next few seconds.

champion_abilities.name: Riposte
champion_abilities.description: Fiora parries all incoming damage and disables for a short time, then stabs in a direction. This stab slows the first enemy champion hit, or stuns them if Fiora blocked an immobilizing effect with this ability.

champion_abilities.name: Skip 'n Slash
champion_abilities.description: Gwen dashes a short distance then gains Attack Speed, attack range, and magic damage <OnHit>On-Hit</OnHit> for a few seconds. If she hits an enemy during that time, this Ability's cooldown is partially refunded.

champion_abilities.name: A Thousand Cuts
champion_abilities.description: Gwen's attacks deal bonus magic damage based on the targets health. She heals for a portion of the damage dealt to champions by this effect.

champion_abilities.name: Snip Snip!
champion_abilities.description: Gwen snips her scissors in a cone up to 6 times dealing magic damage. Gwen deals true damage to units in the center and applies her passive to them on each snip.

champion_abilities.name: Needlework
champion_abilities.description:
Gwen hurls a needle that slows enemies hit, deals magic damage, and applies A Thousand Cuts to champions hit.

This ability can be cast up to two more times, with each cast throwing additional needles and dealing more damage.

champion_abilities.name: Hallowed Mist
champion_abilities.description: Gwen summons mist that protects her from enemies outside of it. She can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist.

champion_abilities.name: Counter Strike
champion_abilities.description: Jax's combat prowess allows him to dodge all incoming attacks for a short duration and then quickly counterattack, stunning all surrounding enemies.

champion_abilities.name: Relentless Assault
champion_abilities.description: Jax's consecutive basic attacks continuously increase his Attack Speed.

champion_abilities.name: Leap Strike
champion_abilities.description: Jax leaps toward a unit. If they are an enemy, he strikes them with his weapon.

champion_abilities.name: Grandmaster-at-Arms
champion_abilities.description: Every third consecutive attack deals additional Magic Damage. Additionally, Jax can activate this ability to deal damage around himself and strengthen his resolve, increasing his Armor and Magic Resist for a short duration.

champion_abilities.name: Empower
champion_abilities.description: Jax charges his weapon with energy, causing his next attack to deal additional damage.

champion_abilities.name: Tempest / Cripple
champion_abilities.description:
Tempest: Lee Sin smashes the ground, sending out a shockwave that deals magic damage and reveals enemy units hit. If Tempest hits an enemy, Lee Sin can cast cripple.
Cripple: Lee Sin cripples nearby enemies damaged by Tempest, reducing their Move Speed. Move Speed recovers gradually over the duration.

champion_abilities.name: Flurry
champion_abilities.description: After Lee Sin uses an ability, his next 2 basic attacks gain Attack Speed and return Energy.

champion_abilities.name: Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike
champion_abilities.description:
Sonic Wave: Lee Sin projects a discordant wave of sound to locate his enemies, dealing physical damage to the first enemy it encounters. If Sonic Wave hits, Lee Sin can cast Resonating Strike for the next 3 seconds.
Resonating Strike: Lee Sin dashes to the enemy hit by Sonic Wave, dealing physical damage based on the target's missing Health.

champion_abilities.name: Dragon's Rage
champion_abilities.description: Lee Sin performs a powerful roundhouse kick launching his target back, dealing physical damage to the target and any enemies they collide with. Enemies the target collides with are knocked into the air for a short duration. This technique was taught to him by Jesse Perring, although Lee Sin does not kick players off the map.

champion_abilities.name: Safeguard / Iron Will
champion_abilities.description:
Safeguard: Lee Sin rushes to target ally, shielding himself from damage. If the ally is a champion, they are also shielded. After using Safeguard, Lee Sin can cast Iron Will.
Iron Will: Lee Sin's intense training allows him to thrive in battle. Lee Sin gains Omnivamp.

champion_abilities.description: Lux releases a sphere of light that binds and deals damage to up to two enemy units.

champion_abilities.name: Final Spark
champion_abilities.description: After gathering energy, Lux fires a beam of light that deals damage to all targets in the area. In addition, triggers Lux's passive ability and refreshes the Illumination debuff duration.

champion_abilities.name: Prismatic Barrier
champion_abilities.description: Lux throws her wand and bends the light around any friendly target it touches, protecting them from enemy damage.

champion_abilities.description: Poppy dashes to the target and pushes it back. If the target is pushed into a wall, it is stunned.

champion_abilities.name: Iron Ambassador

champion_abilities.description: Poppy swings her hammer, dealing damage and creating a zone that will slow enemies and explode after a delay.

champion_abilities.name: Steadfast Presence
