lexical_vocabulary.purpose: Bounded League of Legends lexical snapshot used only as Pass 1 mechanical-cleanup hints (ability keys, common summoner spells, basic domain tokens, and explicit champion alias spelling rules). It is intentionally not a semantic ontology and carries no ownership or champion-binding information; champion alias rules are lexical spelling data only and never produce entities, bindings, events, or relations.
lexical_vocabulary.scope_note: No ownership inference, no champion/role/motif classification, no champion binding, and no strategic abstraction. Champion alias hints are deterministic exact word-boundary spelling hints; guarded aliases require champion-shaped local syntax, metadata-licensed aliases require the supplied metadata value, and the never/uncertainty-only list must never be auto-repaired. Hints may only disambiguate local ASR surface forms in Pass 1 text restoration.

direct.note: Capital-initial Kale surfaces are unconditional Kayle hints; lowercase 'kale' (grocery/vegetable usage) is never eligible. The capitalization guard is documented and encoded in this rule.

metadata_licensed.note: Only eligible when the supplied champion metadata contains Darius; never inferred globally because Varus is a competing lexical possibility.

never.note: Soie is never an automatic Zoe repair; it may only be recorded as a DOMAIN_TOKEN_UNCERTAIN uncertainty with Zoe among the alternatives.

champion_abilities.name: Heroic Swing
champion_abilities.description: Akshan fires a grappling hook into terrain then swings around it, repeatedly firing at the nearest enemy while swinging. He can jump off early or gets knocked off when colliding with champions or terrain.

champion_abilities.name: Dirty Fighting
champion_abilities.description:
Every three hits from Akshan's Attacks and Abilities deals bonus damage and grants him a Shield if the target was a champion.

When Akshan Attacks, he fires an additional Attack for reduced damage. If he cancels the additional Attack, he instead gains Move Speed.

champion_abilities.name: Avengerang
champion_abilities.description: Akshan throws a boomerang that deals damage going out and coming back, extending its range each time it hits an enemy.

champion_abilities.name: Comeuppance
champion_abilities.description: Akshan locks onto an enemy champion and starts storing bullets. When released, he fires all stored bullets, dealing damage based on missing health to the first champion, minion, or structure hit.

champion_abilities.name: Going Rogue
champion_abilities.description:
Akshan passively marks enemy champions as Scoundrels when they kill his ally champions. If Akshan kills a Scoundrel, he resurrects the allies they killed, gains bonus gold, and clears all marks.

When activated, Akshan enters camouflage and gains Move Speed and Mana Regen while moving towards Scoundrels. Akshan loses the camouflage quickly while he is not in brush or near terrain.

champion_abilities.name: Frostbite
champion_abilities.description: With a flap of her wings, Anivia blasts a freezing gust of wind at her target, dealing damage. If the target was recently hit by Flash Frost or damaged by a fully formed Glacial Storm, the damage they take is doubled.

champion_abilities.name: Rebirth
champion_abilities.description: Upon taking fatal damage, Anivia reverts to an egg and is reborn with full health.

champion_abilities.name: Flash Frost
champion_abilities.description: Anivia brings her wings together and summons a sphere of ice that flies towards her opponents, chilling and damaging anyone in its path. When the sphere explodes it does moderate damage in a radius, stunning anyone in the area.

champion_abilities.name: Glacial Storm
champion_abilities.description: Anivia summons a driving rain of ice and hail to damage her enemies and slow their advance.

champion_abilities.name: Crystallize
champion_abilities.description: Anivia condenses the moisture in the air into an impassable wall of ice to block all movement. The wall only lasts a short duration before it melts.

champion_abilities.name: Magical Journey
champion_abilities.description: Bard opens a portal in nearby terrain. Allies and enemies alike can take a one-way trip through that terrain by moving into the portal.

champion_abilities.name: Traveler's Call
champion_abilities.description:
Meeps: Bard attracts lesser spirits that assist with his basic attacks to deal extra magic damage. When Bard has collected enough Chimes, his meeps will also deal damage in an area and slow enemies hit.

Chimes: Ancient chimes randomly appear for Bard to collect. These grant experience, restore mana, and provide out of combat Move Speed.

champion_abilities.name: Cosmic Binding
champion_abilities.description: Bard fires a missile which will slow the first enemy struck, and continue onward. If it strikes a wall, it will stun the initial target; if it strikes another enemy, it will stun them both.

champion_abilities.name: Tempered Fate
champion_abilities.description: Bard sends spirit energy arcing to a location, putting all champions, minions, monsters, and turrets hit into stasis for a brief time.

champion_abilities.name: Caretaker's Shrine
champion_abilities.description: Reveals a Health shrine which powers up over a short time, disappearing after healing and speeding up the first ally that touches it.

champion_abilities.name: 90 Caliber Net
champion_abilities.description: Caitlyn fires a heavy net to slow her target. The recoil knocks Caitlyn back.

champion_abilities.name: Headshot
champion_abilities.description: Every few basic attacks, or against a target she has trapped or netted, Caitlyn will fire a headshot dealing bonus damage that scales with her critical strike chance. On trapped or netted targets, Caitlyn's Headshot attack range is doubled.

champion_abilities.name: Piltover Peacemaker
champion_abilities.description: Caitlyn revs up her rifle for 1 second to unleash a penetrating shot that deals physical damage (deals less damage to subsequent targets).

champion_abilities.name: Ace in the Hole
champion_abilities.description: Caitlyn takes time to line up the perfect shot, dealing massive damage to a single target at a huge range. Enemy champions can intercept the bullet for their ally.

champion_abilities.name: Yordle Snap Trap
champion_abilities.description: Caitlyn sets a trap that, when sprung, reveals and immobilizes the enemy champion for 1.5 seconds, granting Caitlyn an empowered Headshot.

champion_abilities.name: Whiplash
champion_abilities.description: Evelynn whips her target with her Lasher, dealing damage. She then gains Move Speed for a short duration.

champion_abilities.name: Demon Shade
champion_abilities.description: When out of combat, Evelynn enters Demon Shade. Demon Shade heals Evelynn when she is low on health and grants Camouflage after level 6.

champion_abilities.name: Hate Spike
champion_abilities.description: Evelynn strikes out with her Lasher, dealing damage to the first unit hit. Then, Evelynn can shoot a line of spikes at nearby foes a few times.

champion_abilities.name: Last Caress
champion_abilities.description: Evelynn briefly goes untargetable and decimates the area in front of her before warping backwards a long distance.

champion_abilities.name: Allure
champion_abilities.description: Evelynn curses her target, causing her next attack or spell after a delay to charm her target and reduce their magic resist.

champion_abilities.name: Arcane Shift
champion_abilities.description: Ezreal teleports to a target nearby location and fires a homing bolt which strikes the nearest enemy unit. Prioritizes enemies stuck with Essence Flux.

champion_abilities.name: Rising Spell Force
champion_abilities.description: Ezreal gains increasing Attack Speed each time he successfully hits a spell, stacking up to 5 times.

champion_abilities.name: Mystic Shot
champion_abilities.description: Ezreal fires a damaging bolt of energy which reduces all of his cooldowns slightly if it strikes an enemy unit.

champion_abilities.name: Trueshot Barrage
champion_abilities.description: Ezreal winds up before firing a powerful barrage of energy that deals massive damage to each unit it passes through (damage is reduced for minions and non-epic monsters).

champion_abilities.name: Essence Flux
champion_abilities.description: Ezreal fires an orb that sticks to the first champion or objective hit. If Ezreal hits an enemy with the orb, it detonates and deals damage.

champion_abilities.name: Quickdraw
champion_abilities.description: Graves dashes forward gaining an Armor and Magic Resist boost for several seconds. If Graves dashes towards an enemy champion, gain two stacks of True Grit instead. Hitting enemies with basic attacks lowers the cooldown of this skill and refreshes the resistance boost.

champion_abilities.name: New Destiny
champion_abilities.description: Graves' shotgun has some unique properties. He must reload when he runs out of ammo. Attacks fire 4 bullets, which cannot pass through units. Non-champions struck by multiple bullets are knocked back.

champion_abilities.name: End of the Line
champion_abilities.description: Graves fires an explosive shell that detonates after 1 second, or after colliding with terrain.

champion_abilities.name: Collateral Damage
champion_abilities.description: Graves fires an explosive shell dealing heavy damage to the first champion it hits. After hitting a champion or reaching the end of its range, the shell explodes dealing damage in a cone.

champion_abilities.name: Smoke Screen
champion_abilities.description: Graves fires a smoke canister at the target area creating a cloud of smoke that reduces sight range. Enemies caught in the initial impact are dealt magic damage and have their Move Speed reduced briefly.

champion_abilities.name: Flame Chompers!
champion_abilities.description: Jinx throws out a line of snare grenades that explode after 5 seconds, lighting enemies on fire. Flame Chompers will bite enemy champions who walk over them, rooting them in place.

champion_abilities.name: Get Excited!
champion_abilities.description: Jinx receives massively increased Move Speed and Attack Speed whenever she helps kill or destroy an enemy champions epic jungle monster, or structure.

champion_abilities.name: Switcheroo!
champion_abilities.description: Jinx modifies her basic attacks by swapping between Pow-Pow, her minigun and Fishbones, her rocket launcher. Attacks with Pow-Pow grant Attack Speed, while attacks with Fishbones deal area of effect damage, gain increased range, but drain Mana and attack slower.

champion_abilities.name: Super Mega Death Rocket!
champion_abilities.description: Jinx fires a super rocket across the map that gains damage as it travels. The rocket will explode upon colliding with an enemy champion, dealing damage to it and surrounding enemies based on their missing Health.

champion_abilities.name: Zap!
champion_abilities.description: Jinx uses Zapper, her shock pistol, to fire a blast that deals damage to the first enemy hit, slowing and revealing it.

champion_abilities.name: Supercharge
champion_abilities.description:
Kai'Sa briefly increases her Move Speed, then increases her Attack Speed.

Living Weapon: Supercharge is upgraded to briefly grant Invisibility.

champion_abilities.name: Second Skin
champion_abilities.description: Kai'Sa's basic attacks stack Plasma, dealing increasing bonus magic damage. Allies' immobilizing effects help stack Plasma. Additionally, Kai'Sa's item purchases upgrade her basic spells to have more powerful properties.

champion_abilities.name: Icathian Rain
champion_abilities.description:
Kai'Sa shoots a swarm of missiles that seek out nearby targets.

Living Weapon: Icathian Rain is upgraded to shoot more missiles.

champion_abilities.name: Killer Instinct
champion_abilities.description: Kai'Sa dashes near an enemy champion.

champion_abilities.name: Void Seeker
champion_abilities.description:
Kai'Sa shoots a long range missile, marking enemies with her passive.

Living Weapon: Void Seeker is upgraded to apply more passive marks and reduce cooldown on champion hit.

champion_abilities.name: Inspire
champion_abilities.description:
Karma summons a protective shield that absorbs incoming damage and increases the Move Speed of the protected ally.

Mantra Bonus: Energy radiates out from her target, strengthening the initial shield and applying Inspire to nearby allied champions.

champion_abilities.name: Gathering Fire
champion_abilities.description: Karma's damaging abilities will reduce the cooldown of Mantra.

champion_abilities.name: Inner Flame
champion_abilities.description:
Karma sends forth a ball of spirit energy that explodes and deals damage upon hitting an enemy unit.

Mantra Bonus: In addition to the explosion, Mantra increases the destructive power of her Inner Flame, creating a cataclysm which deals damage after a short delay.

champion_abilities.name: Mantra
champion_abilities.description: Karma empowers her next ability to do an additional effect. Mantra is available at level 1 and does not require a skill point.

champion_abilities.name: Focused Resolve
champion_abilities.description:
Karma creates a tether between herself and a targeted enemy, dealing damage and revealing them. If the tether is not broken, the enemy will be rooted and damaged again.

Mantra Bonus: Karma strengthens the link, healing herself and extending the root duration.

champion_abilities.name: Lightning Rush
champion_abilities.description: Kennen morphs into a lightning form, enabling him to pass through units and apply a Mark of the Storm. Kennen gains Move Speed when entering this form, and attack speed when leaving it.

champion_abilities.name: Mark of the Storm
champion_abilities.description: Kennen stuns enemies he hits 3 times with his abilities.

champion_abilities.name: Thundering Shuriken
champion_abilities.description: Kennen throws a fast moving shuriken towards a location, causing damage and adding a Mark of the Storm to any opponent that it hits.

champion_abilities.name: Slicing Maelstrom
champion_abilities.description: Kennen summons a storm that strikes at nearby enemy champions for magical damage.

champion_abilities.name: Electrical Surge
champion_abilities.description: Kennen passively deals extra damage and adds a Mark of the Storm to his target every few attacks, and he can activate this ability to damage and add another Mark of the Storm to targets who are already marked.

champion_abilities.name: Void Ooze
champion_abilities.description: Kog'Maw launches a peculiar ooze which damages all enemies it passes through and leaves a trail which slows enemies who stand on it.

champion_abilities.name: Icathian Surprise
champion_abilities.description: 4 seconds after dying, Kogmaw explodes, dealing true damage to surrounding enemies.

champion_abilities.name: Caustic Spittle
champion_abilities.description: Kog'Maw launches a corrosive projectile which deals magic damage and corrodes the target's armor and magic resist for a short time. Kog'Maw also gains additional attack speed.

champion_abilities.name: Living Artillery
champion_abilities.description: Kog'Maw fires an artillery shell at a great distance dealing magic damage (increased significantly on low health enemies) and revealing non-stealthed targets. Additionally, multiple Living Artilleries in a short period of time cause them to cost additional Mana.

champion_abilities.name: Bio-Arcane Barrage
champion_abilities.description: Kog'Maw's attacks gain range and deal a percent of the target's maximum health as magic damage.

champion_abilities.name: Zenith Blade
champion_abilities.description: Leona projects a solar image of her sword, dealing magic damage to all enemies in a line. When the image fades, the last enemy champion struck will be briefly immobilized and Leona will dash to them.

champion_abilities.name: Sunlight
champion_abilities.description: Damaging spells afflict enemies with Sunlight for 1.5 seconds. When allied Champions deal damage to those targets, they consume the Sunlight to deal additional magic damage.

champion_abilities.name: Shield of Daybreak
champion_abilities.description: Leona uses her shield to perform her next basic attack, dealing bonus magic damage and stunning the target.

champion_abilities.name: Solar Flare
champion_abilities.description: Leona calls down a beam of solar energy, dealing damage to enemies in an area. Enemies in the center of the area are stunned, while enemies on the outside are slowed.

champion_abilities.name: Eclipse
champion_abilities.description: Leona raises her shield to gain Damage Reduction, Armor, and Magic Resist. When the duration first ends, if there are nearby enemies, she will deal magic damage to them and prolong the duration of the effect.

champion_abilities.name: Relentless Pursuit
champion_abilities.description: Lucian quickly dashes a short distance. Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown.

champion_abilities.name: Lightslinger
champion_abilities.description: Whenever Lucian uses an ability, his next attack becomes a double-shot. When Lucian is healed or shielded by an ally, or when a nearby enemy Champion is immobilized, his next 2 basic attacks will deal bonus magic damage.

champion_abilities.name: Piercing Light
champion_abilities.description: Lucian shoots a bolt of piercing light through a target.

champion_abilities.name: The Culling
champion_abilities.description: Lucian unleashes a torrent of shots from his weapons.

champion_abilities.name: Ardent Blaze
champion_abilities.description: Lucian shoots a missile that explodes in a star shape, marking and briefly revealing enemies. Lucian gains Move Speed for attacking marked enemies.

champion_abilities.name: Help, Pix!
champion_abilities.description: If cast on an ally, commands Pix to jump to an ally and shield them. He then follows them and aids their attacks. If cast on an enemy, commands Pix to jump to an enemy and damage them. He then follows them and grants you vision of that enemy.

champion_abilities.name: Pix, Faerie Companion
champion_abilities.description: Pix fires magical bolts of energy whenever the champion he's following attacks another enemy unit. These bolts are homing, but can be intercepted by other units.

champion_abilities.name: Glitterlance
champion_abilities.description: Pix and Lulu each fire a bolt of magical energy that damages and heavily slows all enemies it hits.

champion_abilities.name: Wild Growth
champion_abilities.description: Lulu enlarges an ally, knocking nearby enemies into the air and granting the ally a large amount of bonus health. For the next few seconds, that ally gains an aura that slows nearby enemies.

champion_abilities.name: Whimsy
champion_abilities.description: If cast on an ally, grants them Attack Speed and Move Speed for a short time. If cast on an enemy, turns them into an adorable critter that can't attack or cast spells.

champion_abilities.name: Ground Slam
champion_abilities.description: Malphite slams the ground, sending out a shockwave that deals magic damage based on his Armor and reduces the Attack Speed of enemies for a short duration.

champion_abilities.name: Granite Shield
champion_abilities.description: Malphite is shielded by a layer of rock which absorbs damage up to 10% of his maximum Health. If Malphite has not been hit for a few seconds, this effect recharges.

champion_abilities.name: Seismic Shard
champion_abilities.description: Malphite sends a shard of the earth through the ground at his foe, dealing damage upon impact and stealing Move Speed for 3 seconds.

champion_abilities.name: Unstoppable Force
champion_abilities.description: Malphite launches himself to a location at high speed, damaging enemies and knocking them into the air.

champion_abilities.name: Thunderclap
champion_abilities.description: Malphite attacks with such force that it creates a sonic boom. For the next few seconds, his attacks create aftershocks in front of him.

champion_abilities.name: Malefic Visions
champion_abilities.description:
Malzahar infects his target's mind with cruel visions of their demise, dealing damage over time. Using Malzahar's other spells on the target will refresh the visions.

If the target dies while afflicted by the visions, they pass on to a nearby enemy unit and Malzahar gains Mana. Malzahar's Voidlings are attracted to affected units.

champion_abilities.name: Void Shift
champion_abilities.description: When he hasn't recently taken damage or been crowd controlled, Malzahar gains massive damage reduction and crowd control immunity, lingering for a short period after taking damage.

champion_abilities.name: Call of the Void
champion_abilities.description: Malzahar opens up two portals to the Void. After a short delay, they fire projectiles that deal Magic Damage and silence enemy champions.

champion_abilities.name: Nether Grasp
champion_abilities.description: Malzahar channels the essence of the Void to suppress an enemy champion over a zone of damaging negative energy.

champion_abilities.name: Void Swarm
champion_abilities.description: Malzahar summons Voidlings to attack nearby enemies.

champion_abilities.name: Solar Snare
champion_abilities.description: Mel fires a radiant orb forward, rooting those at its center while the area around it slows enemies and deals damage over time.

champion_abilities.name: Searing Brilliance
champion_abilities.description:
Whenever Mel uses an ability, she gains three bonus projectiles (up to nine maximum) on her next attack.

When Mel deals damage through an ability or attack, she applies Overwhelm, which can stack infinitely. If the enemy is hit by Mel with enough Overwhelm damage, the stacks are consumed to execute the target.

champion_abilities.name: Radiant Volley
champion_abilities.description: Mel fires a barrage of projectiles that explode around a target location, dealing damage repeatedly to enemies within the area.

champion_abilities.name: Golden Eclipse
champion_abilities.description:
Mel strikes all enemies marked with Overwhelm regardless of their distance from her, dealing additional damage for each stack of Overwhelm.

Ranks of Golden Eclipse increase Overwhelm's damage.

champion_abilities.name: Rebuttal
champion_abilities.description: Mel forms a barrier around herself that reflects enemy projectiles back at the attacker, prevents her from taking damage, and grants her movement speed.

champion_abilities.name: Command: Protect
champion_abilities.description: Orianna commands her Ball to attach to an allied champion, Shielding them and dealing magic damage to any enemies it passes through on the way. Additionally, the Ball grants additional Armor and Magic Resist to the champion it is attached to.

champion_abilities.name: Clockwork Windup
champion_abilities.description: Orianna's Attacks deal additional magic damage. This damage increases the more Orianna Attacks the same target.

champion_abilities.name: Command: Attack
champion_abilities.description: Orianna commands her Ball to fire toward a target location, dealing magic damage to targets along the way (deals less damage to subsequent targets). Her Ball remains at the target location after.

champion_abilities.name: Command: Shockwave
champion_abilities.description: Orianna commands her Ball to unleash a shockwave, dealing magic damage and launching nearby enemies towards the Ball after a short delay.

champion_abilities.name: Command: Dissonance
champion_abilities.description: Orianna commands her Ball to release a pulse of energy, dealing magic damage around it. This leaves a field behind that speeds up allies and slows enemies.

champion_abilities.name: Heroic Charge
champion_abilities.description: Poppy dashes to the target and pushes it back. If the target is pushed into a wall, it is stunned.

champion_abilities.name: Iron Ambassador
champion_abilities.description: Poppy throws her buckler that bounces off the target. Poppy can pick it up to gain a temporary shield.

champion_abilities.name: Hammer Shock
champion_abilities.description: Poppy swings her hammer, dealing damage and creating a zone that will slow enemies and explode after a delay.

champion_abilities.name: Keeper's Verdict
champion_abilities.description: Poppy channels a hammer strike that knocks enemies very far away.

champion_abilities.name: Steadfast Presence
champion_abilities.description: Poppy passively gains Armor and Magic Resist. This bonus increases when she is low on Health. Poppy can activate Steadfast Presence to gain Move Speed and stop enemy dashes around her. If a dash is stopped, the enemy is slowed and grounded.

champion_abilities.name: Vault
champion_abilities.description: Quinn dashes to an enemy, dealing physical damage and slowing the target's Move Speed. Upon reaching the target, she leaps off the target, briefly interrupting it, and lands near her maximum Attack Range away from the target.

champion_abilities.name: Harrier
champion_abilities.description: Valor, Quinn's Demacian eagle, periodically marks enemies as <font color='#FFF673'>Vulnerable</font>. Quinn's first basic attack against <font color='#FFF673'>Vulnerable</font> targets will deal bonus physical damage.

champion_abilities.name: Blinding Assault
champion_abilities.description: Quinn calls Valor to mark an enemy and hinder its vision before damaging all enemies in the immediate area.

champion_abilities.name: Behind Enemy Lines
champion_abilities.description: Quinn and Valor team up to fly around at great speed.  Ending the ability casts Skystrike, which deals damage to nearby enemies and marks champions as Vulnerable.

champion_abilities.name: Heightened Senses
champion_abilities.description: Passively grants Quinn Attack Speed and Move Speed after she attacks a <font color='#FFF673'>Vulnerable</font> target. Activate to have Valor reveal a large area nearby.

champion_abilities.name: Valor
champion_abilities.description: Riven steps forward a short distance and blocks incoming damage.

champion_abilities.name: Runic Blade
champion_abilities.description: Riven's abilities charge her blade, and her basic attacks expend charges to deal an additional damage.

champion_abilities.name: Broken Wings
champion_abilities.description: Riven lashes out in a series of strikes. This ability can be reactivated three times in a short time frame with the third hit knocking back nearby enemies.

champion_abilities.name: Blade of the Exile
champion_abilities.description: Riven empowers her keepsake weapon with energy, and gains Attack Damage and Range. During this time, she also gains the ability to use Wind Slash, a powerful ranged attack, once.

champion_abilities.name: Ki Burst
champion_abilities.description: Riven emits a Ki Burst, damaging and stunning nearby enemies.

champion_abilities.name: Shadow Dash
champion_abilities.description: Shen dashes in a direction, taunting enemies in his path.

champion_abilities.name: Ki Barrier
champion_abilities.description: After casting a spell, Shen gets a shield. Affecting other champions reduces the cooldown of this effect.

champion_abilities.name: Twilight Assault
champion_abilities.description: Shen recalls his spirit blade to attack with it, dealing damage based on the target's max health. The attacks are greatly empowered if it collides with an enemy champion, and all collided enemies are slowed while running away from Shen.

champion_abilities.name: Stand United
champion_abilities.description: Shen shields target allied champion from incoming damage, and soon after teleports to their location.

champion_abilities.name: Spirit's Refuge
champion_abilities.description: Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked.

champion_abilities.name: Fling
champion_abilities.description: Damages target enemy unit and flings them into the air behind Singed. If the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted.

champion_abilities.name: Noxious Slipstream
champion_abilities.description: Singed drafts off nearby champions, gaining a burst of Move Speed when passing them.

champion_abilities.name: Poison Trail
champion_abilities.description: Leaves a trail of poison behind Singed, dealing damage to enemies caught in the path.

champion_abilities.name: Insanity Potion
champion_abilities.description: Singed drinks a potent brew of chemicals, granting him increased combat stats, and making his Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds.

champion_abilities.name: Mega Adhesive
champion_abilities.description: Throws a vial of mega adhesive on the ground, slowing and grounding enemies who walk on it.

champion_abilities.name: Spell Shield
champion_abilities.description: Creates a magical barrier that blocks a single enemy ability cast on Sivir. She receives health and a burst of movement speed if a spell is blocked.

champion_abilities.name: Fleet of Foot
champion_abilities.description: Sivir gains a short burst of Move Speed when she attacks an enemy champion.

champion_abilities.name: Boomerang Blade
champion_abilities.description: Sivir hurls her crossblade like a boomerang, dealing damage each way.

champion_abilities.name: On The Hunt
champion_abilities.description: Sivir leads her allies in battle, granting them a surge of Move Speed for a period of time. In addition, Sivir's attacks reduce her spell cooldowns.

champion_abilities.name: Ricochet
champion_abilities.description: Sivir's next few basic attacks gain additional attack speed and bounce to nearby targets, dealing reduced damage while bouncing.

champion_abilities.name: Nevermove
champion_abilities.description: Swain launches a wave of demonic power forward. It then returns to Swain and roots enemies it hits. Swain can then choose to pull all rooted champions closer. This ability has a shorter cooldown during Demonic Ascension.

champion_abilities.name: Ravenous Flock
champion_abilities.description: Swain's ravens collect Soul Fragments that heal him and permanently increase his maximum health.

champion_abilities.name: Death's Hand
champion_abilities.description: Swain unleashes several bolts of eldritch power that pierce through enemies. Enemies hit take more damage for each bolt they are struck by.

champion_abilities.name: Demonic Ascension
champion_abilities.description: Swain transforms into a demon and drains health from nearby enemy champions, minions, and neutral monsters. Swain can cast Demonflare to decimate and slow nearby enemies with a nova of soulfire. This form is indefinite as long as Swain drains enemy champions.

champion_abilities.name: Vision of Empire
champion_abilities.description: Swain opens a demon eye that deals damage and slows enemies. Champions hit are revealed and also grant Swain a Soul Fragment.

champion_abilities.name: Scatter the Weak
champion_abilities.description: Syndra knocks enemies and Dark Spheres back dealing magic damage. Enemies hit by Dark Spheres become stunned.

champion_abilities.name: Transcendent
champion_abilities.description:
Syndra collects Splinters of Wrath from gaining levels and damaging enemies which upgrade her abilities.

Dark Sphere: Syndra can hold an additional charge
Force of Will: Bonus true damage.
Scatter the Weak: Increased width and slows all targets
Unleashed Power: Executes low health targets

champion_abilities.name: Dark Sphere
champion_abilities.description: Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere dealing magic damage. The sphere remains and can be manipulated by her other powers.

champion_abilities.name: Unleashed Power
champion_abilities.description: Syndra bombards an enemy Champion with all of her Dark Spheres.

champion_abilities.name: Force of Will
champion_abilities.description: Syndra picks up and throws a Dark Sphere or enemy minion dealing magic damage and slowing the Move Speed of enemies.

champion_abilities.name: Assassin's Path
champion_abilities.description: Talon vaults over any terrain or structure, up to a max distance. This ability has a low cooldown, but puts the used terrain on a long cooldown.

champion_abilities.name: Blade's End
champion_abilities.description: Talon's spells Wound champions and large monsters, stacking up to 3 times. When Talon attacks a champion with 3 stacks of Wound, they bleed for heavy damage over time.

champion_abilities.name: Noxian Diplomacy
champion_abilities.description: Talon stabs the target unit. If they are within melee range, this attack deals critical damage. If they are outside melee range, Talon will leap at his target before stabbing them. Talon refunds some health and cooldown if this ability kills the target.

champion_abilities.name: Shadow Assault
champion_abilities.description: Talon disperses a ring of blades and becomes Invisible while gaining additional Move Speed. When Talon emerges from Invisibility, the blades converge on his location. Each time the blades move, Shadow Assault deals physical damage to enemies hit by at least one blade.

champion_abilities.name: Rake
champion_abilities.description: Talon sends out a volley of daggers that then return back to him, dealing physical damage every time it passes through an enemy. The returning blades deal bonus damage and slow units hit.

champion_abilities.name: Spinning Slash
champion_abilities.description: Tryndamere slices toward a target unit, dealing damage to enemies in his path.

champion_abilities.name: Battle Fury
champion_abilities.description: Tryndamere gains Fury for each attack, critical strike, and killing blow he makes. Fury passively increases his Critical Strike Chance and can be consumed with his Bloodlust spell.

champion_abilities.name: Bloodlust
champion_abilities.description: Tryndamere thrives on the thrills of combat, increasing his Attack Damage as he is more and more wounded. He can cast Bloodlust to consume his Fury and heal himself.

champion_abilities.name: Undying Rage
champion_abilities.description: Tryndamere's lust for battle becomes so strong that he is unable to die, no matter how wounded he becomes.

champion_abilities.name: Mocking Shout
champion_abilities.description: Tryndamere lets out an insulting cry, decreasing surrounding champions' Attack Damage. Enemies with their backs turned to Tryndamere also have their Move Speed reduced.

champion_abilities.name: Hail of Arrows
champion_abilities.description: Varus fires a hail of arrows that deal physical damage and desecrate the ground. Desecrated ground slows enemies' Move Speed and reduces their self healing and regeneration.

champion_abilities.name: Living Vengeance
champion_abilities.description: On kill or assist, Varus temporarily gains Attack Damage and Ability Power. This bonus is larger if the enemy is a champion.

champion_abilities.name: Piercing Arrow
champion_abilities.description: Varus readies and then fires a powerful shot that gains extra range and damage the longer he spends preparing to fire.

champion_abilities.name: Chain of Corruption
champion_abilities.description: Varus flings out a damaging tendril of corruption that immobilizes the first enemy champion hit and then spreads towards nearby uninfected champions, immobilizing them too on contact.

champion_abilities.name: Blighted Quiver
champion_abilities.description: Passive: Varus' basic attacks deal bonus magic damage and apply Blight. Varus' other abilities detonate Blight, dealing magic damage based on the target's maximum Health. Active: Varus empowers his next Piercing Arrow.

champion_abilities.name: Event Horizon
champion_abilities.description: Veigar twists the edges of space, creating a cage that Stuns enemies that pass through.

champion_abilities.name: Phenomenal Evil Power
champion_abilities.description: Veigar is the greatest Evil to ever strike at the hearts of Runeterra - and he's only getting bigger! Striking an enemy Champion with a spell or scoring a takedown grants Veigar permanently increased Ability Power.

champion_abilities.name: Baleful Strike
champion_abilities.description: Veigar unleashes a bolt of dark energy that deals magic damage to the first two enemies hit. Units killed by this bolt grant Veigar some ability power permanently.

champion_abilities.name: Primordial Burst
champion_abilities.description: Blasts target enemy champion, dealing a large amount of magic damage, increasing based on the target's missing health.

champion_abilities.name: Dark Matter
champion_abilities.description: Veigar calls a great mass of dark matter to fall from the sky to the target location, dealing magic damage when it lands. Stacks of Phenomenal Evil reduce Dark Matter's cooldown.

champion_abilities.name: Tectonic Disruption
champion_abilities.description: Vel'Koz causes an area to explode, knocking up enemies, and knocking close enemies slightly away.

champion_abilities.name: Organic Deconstruction
champion_abilities.description: Vel'Koz's abilities apply <keywordName>Organic Deconstruction</keywordName> to enemies on hit. If 3 stacks are accumulated, the enemy will take a burst of true damage.

champion_abilities.name: Plasma Fission
champion_abilities.description: Vel'Koz shoots a bolt of plasma that splits in two on reactivation or upon hitting an enemy. The bolt slows and damages on hit.

champion_abilities.name: Life Form Disintegration Ray
champion_abilities.description: Vel'Koz unleashes a channelled beam that follows the cursor for 2.5 seconds that deals magic damage. Organic Deconstruction Researches enemy champions causing them to take true damage instead.

champion_abilities.name: Void Rift
champion_abilities.description: Vel'Koz opens a rift to the void that deals an initial burst of damage, then explodes for a second burst of damage after a delay.

champion_abilities.name: Sweeping Blade
champion_abilities.description:
Dashes through target enemy, dealing magic damage. Each cast increases subsequent dash's damage, up to a max amount.

Cannot be re-cast on the same enemy for a few seconds.

If Steel Tempest is cast while dashing, it will strike as a circle.

champion_abilities.name: Way of the Wanderer
champion_abilities.description: Yasuo's Critical Strike Chance is increased. Additionally, Yasuo builds toward a shield whenever he is moving. The shield triggers when he takes damage from a champion or monster.

champion_abilities.name: Steel Tempest
champion_abilities.description:
Thrusts forward, damaging all enemies in a line.

On hit, grants a stack of Gathering Storm for a few seconds. At 2 stacks, Steel Tempest fires a whirlwind that knocks Airborne.

Steel Tempest is treated as a basic attack and scales with all the same things.

champion_abilities.name: Last Breath
champion_abilities.description:
Blinks to an Airborne enemy champion, dealing physical damage and holding all Airborne enemies in the area in the air. Grants maximum Flow but resets all stacks of Gathering Storm.

For a moderate time afterwards, Yasuo's critical strikes gain significant Bonus Armor Penetration.

champion_abilities.name: Wind Wall
champion_abilities.description: Creates a moving wall that blocks all enemy projectiles for 4 seconds.

champion_abilities.name: Hexplosive Minefield
champion_abilities.description: Ziggs scatters proximity mines that detonate on enemy contact, dealing magic damage and slowing. Successive mine detonations on the same target deal reduced damage.

champion_abilities.name: Short Fuse
champion_abilities.description: Periodically, Ziggs' next basic attack deals bonus magic damage. This cooldown is reduced whenever Ziggs uses an ability.

champion_abilities.name: Bouncing Bomb
champion_abilities.description: Ziggs throws a bouncing bomb that deals magic damage.

champion_abilities.name: Mega Inferno Bomb
champion_abilities.description: Ziggs deploys his ultimate creation, the Mega Inferno Bomb, hurling it an enormous distance. Enemies in the primary blast zone take more damage than those farther away.

champion_abilities.name: Satchel Charge
champion_abilities.description:
Ziggs flings an explosive charge that detonates after a delay, or when this ability is activated again. The explosion deals magic damage to enemies, knocking them away. Ziggs is also knocked away, but takes no damage.

Ziggs can use the Satchel to hexplode vulnerable enemy turrets.

instructions.role: You are extracting source-grounded semantic information from a League of Legends coaching transcript.
task_rules: Use only information supported by the supplied source material and metadata.
The target passage is marked explicitly; extract meaning FOR THE TARGET PASSAGE.
Resolve pronouns, champion references, and ability ownership only when the supplied material supports the resolution.
Do not invent strategic conclusions that are merely plausible League advice.
Do not normalize results into higher-level strategic concepts such as access, continuity, initiative, beatdown, or conversion unless the coach explicitly states that concept.
Do not repair ASR corruption beyond what the supplied vocabulary and context support; record unrecoverable spans as unresolved.
Preserve uncertainty: use resolution_status 'unresolved' whenever a binding or span cannot be supported.

fields.actors_entities: Champions, players, and other entities the target passage is about. Preserve literal surface names when the source wording is used; mark context-resolved bindings explicitly.
fields.reference_bindings: Every pronoun or reference in the target passage and what it binds to. If a reference cannot be resolved from the supplied material, record it with resolution_status 'unresolved' instead of guessing.
fields.abilities_resources: Ability, summoner spell, item, and resource references, including whose ability each one is when the source supports ownership.
fields.events_actions: Concrete things that happened or were done in the game, as stated or entailed by the source.
fields.states: Game states that hold during the target passage: health, mana, cooldowns, position, wave states, objective states, and similar.
fields.conditions: Explicit or clearly implied conditions under which events, advice, or consequences hold ('if', 'when', 'until', 'unless' content).
fields.recommended_advice: Advice or recommended actions the coach actually gives in the target passage. Do not invent plausible League advice the coach did not state.
fields.consequences_outcomes: Stated or clearly implied consequences and outcomes of events, states, or (non-)compliance with advice.
fields.explicit_relationships: Typed relationships between extracted items using ONLY the supplied relation_types vocabulary. Each relationship must be supported by the source.
fields.uncertainty_unresolved: Spans or bindings the speaker or you are uncertain about, ASR corruptions that cannot be recovered, and references that remain unresolved. Preserving uncertainty is required; resolving it by guessing is forbidden.
fields.supporting_source_spans: The minimal source spans that jointly support the extraction for this target passage.

grounding_rules: Every extracted item must cite at least one source reference.

A source reference is an exact contiguous 'quote' copied byte-for-byte from the condition's supplied source text plus a zero-based 'occurrence_index' counted among all exact non-overlapping substring matches of that quote in the condition source.
Never supply character offsets; deterministic tooling resolves your quotes to ranges.
Condition A source text is the supplied Bronze target passage. Condition B source text is the supplied full transcript.
For explicit_relationships items, relation_type MUST come from the supplied relation_types list.
For supporting_source_spans items, cite the exact quotes that cover the support.

response_contract.shape: Return ONLY one minified JSON object with exactly these keys: schema_version, case_id, condition, payload_sha256, instructions_sha256, fields.
header_rules: schema_version must be exactly 'phase2k-full-transcript-ablation-intermediate-response-v1'.
case_id and condition must copy the payload values exactly.
payload_sha256 and instructions_sha256 must copy the payload hashes exactly.
fields_rules: fields must contain exactly these keys: actors_entities, reference_bindings, abilities_resources, events_actions, states, conditions, recommended_advice, consequences_outcomes, explicit_relationships, uncertainty_unresolved, supporting_source_spans.
Each field value is a possibly-empty array of item objects.

Every item object has exactly the keys: extraction_text (non-empty string, max 2000 chars), resolution_status (one of literal_explicit, context_resolved, vocabulary_supported, unresolved), source_references (non-empty array).
Every source_reference object has exactly the keys: quote (non-empty exact substring of the condition source), occurrence_index (integer >= 0).

Items in the explicit_relationships field additionally have exactly one more key: relation_type (one of ACTOR, TARGET, USES, AFFECTS, CAUSES, ENABLES, PREVENTS, REQUIRES, CONDITION, RESULT, BEFORE, AFTER, UNTIL, NEGATES, REFERS_TO).
